comment: Great teacher, she is so nice! As long as you do the work and come to class then you are going to do fine! I am not a writer at all, and she took the time to give me great feedback and helped me learn a lot about my writing abilities.

She is an angel. Shes so into what she teaches and knows what shes talking about. She gives a lot of good feedback and is pretty flexible. There are a lot of group projects and overall a class I enjoyed taking.
Her class was my favorite by far. She made us reach for our full potential. She opened us up to new possibilities.
Hands down one of the best teachers I've ever had.

comment: MJ is the cutest and sweetest professor on the planet! She teaches creative writing in a unique way and keeps the class interesting, even with boring material. She always has comments and positive feedback when it comes to your writing and loves when you share your work with the class. MJ is an awesome teacher, I would recommend her always!

M.J. is an amazing professor. She clearly laid out what she wanted for the semester. Short stories to read with 1-2 page responses, it was super easy if you just put the time in. The two exams that were given we had a preview of. The books she picks as well are amazing. I would highly recommend her to anyone.

Took her during my first semester at Brockport. Such a nice lady and great teacher. Her quizzes are usually done in a group or given advanced notice. Great class to take to expand your writing talents.

She's an amazing lady! Hilarious, very sweet, a lot like my grandmother. Would take again, you need to at least decently like creative writing to enjoy this class. So small and so much fun!
Very friendly and nice.  Decent grader, nothing too hard just more work than some of the other teachers in same course.

Awesome lady. Nicest person ever and really understanding about everything. If you do the work, you will get a good grade. You do a lot of writing, but it really is a lot of fun. Leaned a lot about 4 genres.  Loved poetry and playwriting.  Who knew I would love plays. She uses great examples of each genre.  Inspiring.  I loved writing the quilt essay. The semester just flew by. She's a professional writer too.

She is a great person, but I feel like I did not learn much from the class. It was a great time, but I didn't really walk away with more creative writing knowledge. Easy and fun A as long as you have a pulse in the class.

Amazing class!  Learned so much.  This was well worth it.  It changed the way I see things.  It made me appreciate writer's craft. loved the writers workshop. So glad i took this course.  it will influence all of my other writing courses.  Hope to take another poetry class.

Had A's and B's on papers. Missed two classes for illness, and one representing the college, and she grew mean. Then she was rude and her contract should not be renewed. If you take a class with her, you will not learn. DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HER!

Great professor and very open to emotion.  a little oversensitive and sometimes misunderstands innocent intentions.  Very helpful with constructive criticism and extremely knowledgeable about local writers.
A very fun person with a great personality!  If you take a class with her you will love her!  She is helpful and an easy grader:)
MJ is a great teacher, she's fun, really nice, and challenged us as writers. I would definitely take another class with her!
I love MJ!!! She's an intellegent, amazing woman, wooo!

I think MJ is absolutley wonderful. In our class of 30, 7 of us followed her to her other class the next semester. She is very friendly and knows her stuff. She is understanding and kind and you won't be disappointed.

Took her class for 3-D design. Genuinely an amazing professor who is very understanding. Most of the class is work time, but she pops around and helps as needed. Overall 10/10.

As long as you showed up and worked then you will be able to pass. She is so chill and was very lenient with critiquing. She always asked if anyone needed help and never made you feel like unheard. personally i would put in a ton of work and she still didnt like my work so I usually got a bad grade

Such a wonderful lady! She makes you work your grade but if you put in the effort she will definitely take that into consideration. Absolutely wants to see her class succeed and grow.

Janet is a great woman. She's not an easy grader, but she will push you to do your best, most creative work. She also truly cares about her students and is fully willing to work with you if you're struggling.

Janet is a wonderful human-being. She enjoys life and helping others and her class proves this. I learned many techniques in drawing, however, her directions are sometimes hard to understand. All around fun class for majors and non-majors.

Great professor. this class i thought would be easier but its actually pretty difficult (if youre not artistic) otherwise i had A LOT of fun. shes always getting you to expand your mind and to try new techniques with artworks. very good about gradding, i highly recomend this class and this professor

Excellent.

comment: I love her! She made a scary class into a much easier class. Notes are lecture style and she provides fill in the blank. It is sometimes difficult to explain your questions but she is really helpful/nice. Lots of easy extra credit opportunities. She really focuses on making sure you learn and your grade will reflect your effort. Would take again!

Dr. Ratliff was not my favorite. She gave chances for extra credit but she makes you work for it. Make sure to know how to write a research paper in APA style before class starts. Once you pick a topic for your research paper, make sure u know what is happening. My group got screwed because we didnt know what we were doing

she does not post notes online, therefore if you miss a day you are screwed. she took 5 points off of my paper for it being more than 2 pages. had a family issue and she still penalized me, although my two other psych professors allowed me time with my family. Dr. Ratcliff is really very nice and her class is pretty clear. Attendance isn't mandatory but it's better that you go. The tests are very textbook heavy so you have to read the whole thing carefully and closely. Offers lots of bonus points!

Ratcliff is a very sweet lady and she cares about your grade! she gives lots of extra credit. she gives a list of what will be on each test so make sure you study that as you go along and you should be able to get an a or b! i also didnt touch my textbook so i wouldnt recommend you buy it ! everything you need to know is in her notes, save the $120

Took Social Psych as a summer course and I'm glad I did. The amount of work wasn't overwhelming and the grading was fair. I felt engaged, not overloaded.

Really good professor. She knows what she's doing and her notes are really helpful. Good sense of humor and amazing review games just make this class awesome!

Logan wasn't a bad professor but she tried to make an already hard class even harder. I understand that there is a lot to cover, but she rushed through the material and I had to teach myself a lot. Logan is so smart that it is hard to understand what she is saying. she does not start off with the basics  You will need to read the book and doing the masterings to understand.

comment: Very hard class. If you don't put the work in you won't pass. All she did was read off of powerpoints and did not go into large detail how to work the problems. I loved  her. Her lectures are usually not boring and the tests are pretty easy. She is easily accessible outside of class and is willing to work with you to improve your grade.
The material was there for the most part. Tests were a bit awkward. Powerpoints are straightforward and on Blackboard so if you're good at Chem don't bother going to every class

i don't even have words for how awful she was. she would ask if everyone understands and when the entire lecture (300 students) said no she laughed and continued on. reads right off the powerpoint, very scatter-brained, spends 15 mins of class talking about office hours and what we are going to learn instead of teaching it. long and boring lectures

She explains everything in a really haphazard way. Her math skills are garbage too. She once did a problem with a calculator and people in the lecture had to argue with her. I took Dr Logan for Organic 1 and I did average with only so much effort being put in. decent professor for such a difficult course (organic chem).  helpful if you seek her out, but there is a lot of work and a lot of it is very hard.  excellent instructor in lab.

Fair, knowledgeable, and always informs you one what she expects and upcoming due dates.  Easily one of the best professors I've ever had.  Organic Chemistry is hard, but she makes it simple if you're willing to put in the work. Also a great pre-med adviser.  I highly recommend.

I HATE ORGO. DR LOGAN IS A NICE LADY BUT THAT DOES NOT MEAN THAT SHE IS A GOOD TEACHER. PAYED ATTENTION TO STUDENTS WHO KNEW WHAT THEY WERE DOING BUT WAS NOT HELPFUL FOR STUDENTS WHO WERE LOST. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS CLASS.

Dr. Logan is great.  She is very motherly and will take you under her wing (not a bad deal considering this is OCHEM) She knows her stuff and is a great teacher.  She also is an incredible resource when it comes to anything pre-med. I love you dr. logan!

Chemistry profs generally suck; she doesn't. Friendly, maybe the most accessible prof I've had, esp. out of office hours. Class has a high workload. Grading is consistent... and grades are low. Do ALL the reading and MANY problems, you'll be fine. Loved the class.
Dr. Logan is great! She remembers everyone's name and has a passion for chemistry. If you don't like her, it's actuallybecause you dislike chemistry. She is very helpful.

In MY rich fantasy life, I would avoid Maggie Logan and her god awful iPad. She is however an extremely intelligent woman and more than willing to help when needed. Like any other TRUE science course, you need to put in the time to be successful and can't expect to squeak by like in other courses.

Nice person, Horrible teacher. Rushed through everything, really boring. Quizzes and tests were hard. I changed my major because of this course. Harsh grader with no curves and OWL homeworks are insanely tidious.

It is always amazing to me what Dr. Logan knows and can remember (including everyone's name). The class is difficult, the quizzes can be difficult but you are fairly warned about everything, I advise you to take those warnings seriously. If you enjoy chemistry you will enjoy this course. The NMR paper late term however I must admit is horrible.

Very enthusiastic teacher with much experience. She knows everyone's name and is understanding/encouraging because she knows that Gen Chem and Organic are required for many majors.

I took organic 1 with Dr. Logan and she was great. she is passionate and will help whenever you need it. its a lot of work, but its organic! it should be a lot of work! Her grading system gives you plenty of room to boost your grade. she gives a bunch of bonus hw too. she is extremely fair. If you do the work, your grade will reflect it!

First off, she's awesome! You can tell she's really passionate about the subject and she brings that passion to the class room. What's more, she remembers almost everyone's names, even after just 1 meeting. Not bad since it's a lecture hall. I thought her explanations were easy to follow, and she is always there to give extra help.
Very Nice but not the best at explaining things. Lots of work.
Nice enough person but gives outrageous amounts of work. It is very easy to fall behind and once you do your toast. Very hard to follow what is going on in class.
She's a very nice person, but impossible to get help from.

she remembers almost 80% of the students names throughout the year. not bad considering how she always makes fun of how old she is. Do your OWLS!! she tells you whats going to be on the exams, the hard part is studying and putting in the hours.

She's very cute in a geeky chem major sort of way. She's extremely intelligent, but it's hard for her to teach her skills to students, and she usually makes you figure it out by yourself. Keep up with the online homework which usually teaches you most of the concepts. Unless your major requires it, I don't recommend taking one of her classes.

You can tell she loves the subject and she really cares about her students. You just have to be willing to ask for help outside of class. The homework is a little annoying but they get the point across and you learn how to compute things. And she is always cracking jokes in class as well.

Class is necessary for a lot of majors, but if you don't have to take it then I wouldn't recommend it. Logan is very enthusiastic about her subject, but she is horrible at explaining things. Class is necessary for a lot of majors, but if you don't have to take it then I wouldn't recommend it. Logan is very enthusiastic about her subject, but she is horrible at explaining things. Great teacher, goes out of her way to help students. For someone who has been teaching for a long time she hasn't lost her sense of humor or love of chemistry. Shes not an old fart professor who just wants to collect paychecks, she really does care.

Chemistry is chemistry.  If you don't do the work, you will fall behind and end up with a bad grade.  However, Dr. Logan tries her *best* to help you succeed.  If you don't do well on the exams, there are plenty of extra points available from clickers and online homework (OWL)

Professor Logan has to be the worst teacher ever. Class lectures are confusing and choppie, most of the time she doesnt even know what she is talking about. If your not one of her pets, dont bother trying to ask a question, she gives lots of attitude and is some what hostile. Compared to other teachers i have heard about, she is the worst.

Logan goes extremely fast really hates it if she runs out of time or doesnt cover something.  If she doesn't have time to cover it in class, she expects you to learn it on your own.  There isn't any explanations of anything, it's more about examples from the book and thats about it.  The book and the owl hw taught me more than she ever did.

She's really nice, but definitely not the best professor to learn chemistry from (if you hate chemistry like me). I feel like I have narcolepsy in her class. It's very boring, but if you don't understand something, Logan will be glad to help you.

I can't say I was too pleased with the year. She did examples and her explanations right from the book...so it's like if you didn't understand the book you wouldn't understand anything...I feel that she had her favorite students, and she was very critical at times when asking her a question. It was a very hard course.

Dr. Logan is the best teacher I ever had! It is absolutely impossible to take her class and not fall in love with Chem. Make sure keep up with Owl homework, study in adcance for tests, and make it a point to do well in lab. Other than that, the class is a breeze!

Logan is a good professor, however much of her notes are examples rather than explanations.  Definetely recommend seeing the tutor.  Also, studying DOES pay off, but you have to do it ahead of time for it to work.

Dr. Logan is an amazing professor!! I just finished general chemistry for the fall semester and I'm looking forward to take the second half next semester. She really isn't that hard... general chemistry was basically the same as high school chem,  she is very very helpful and she is great lab professor also! One of the best I've had!!Def Recommend!
She is a really good teacher if you really have a vested interest in chemistry...if not it sucks

Dr logan is a very nice teacher, she means well and if you need help she'll give you time. The class itself I found to be pretty hard and I don't like chemistry. Her tests are pretty hard studying before hand  for like a week or 2 would be a good idea

Dr. Logan is a brilliant teacher!!! I love the way she makes her lectures really interesting with demonstrations, and simplifies chemistry making it really straightforward to grasp. About 5 or 6 exams, and clicker questions in class. Definitely recommended: take her classes if you can...
She is Great but CHEM IS RIDICULOUS!!!

I am going to miss her! This spring semester for organic chemistry 2 was her last semester teaching it. She was pretty sad that she was leaving us because we were a fun class! She's an excellent teacher! I was shocked this semester she only had 2 A's and majority of people failed with D's and C-'s. I like her!

Great teacher

Great Professor, amazing wealth of knowledge. Best teacher I've met in Brockport so far.
Dr. Logan is a great professor and person. She is one of the few professors that makes me glad I chose SUNY Brockport (makes you wish more professors followed her lead)!

one major group project, normal amount of tests. take half the test on your own and half with a partner or group of 3. Learning labs once a week

Dr. Hiabach is the best Professor. She is extremely helpful and truely loves and cares about what she does. She is absolutely beautiful, smart, funny, sophisticated and classy. The best Professor hands down.

Very nice. Easy tests and simple assignments. Highly recommended.

Her looks make u want to go to class!  Do the review sheets they help!!!

She is a really nice person outside of class, i love her. But in class she can be kinda confusing and she is not that great at explaining things in simple terms.

Kam is a very nice professor. Guitar ensemble is a really fun course and can be taken for credit multiple times. Not a great professor. The class is VERY test heavy. 1 midterm 1 final and 1 final paper. You have 3 shots to pass the class, just 3 the whole year. Dr. Kachiga is so funny, some of the simplest things he says will get you to laugh. lets us out of class early all the time. not very accessible except for office hours. the actual class is very interactive but also interesting when you talk about different topics and hear others' POV. Not bad professor but little bit crazy. Very old school, which mean students are not allowed to go to restroom if someone does go to restroom he will concerned as insult to himself. Some of his information is misleading and off the topic.

Professor Kachiga is, for the most part, a nice man. Do not show up late to his class!! He will call you out on it and he gets very upset when people interrupt his teaching. He only gave a midterm exam, a final exam, and a final essay, making it vital to show up to his classes.

Very informative and detailed in every class. Nice guy and funny at times. Takes attendance only certain days but overall a very awesome class

Dr. Gillespie is my favorite professor I have had in my college career. Every class I have with her makes me want to learn and change my path in psychology. She is incredible and I would recommend taking every class you can with her!

Professor Gillespie is very nice and helpful in her emails! I wouldn't recommend the class for non-majors, but I defiantly found some of the material interesting. Overall, a positive experience with this professor.

Loved her, but clinical psych was the most boring class Ive ever taken. Should be a 1-hour info session for those interested in pursuing a degree in clinical psych only. I found myself saying " who t.f. cares?" throughout the entire class. Did I mention the class is boring?

I absolutely loved Dr. Gillespie's Clinical Psychology course. She is a very informative professor who cares deeply about her students and their success. She is always free to meet and will make time. I liked her so much I am now taking her Community Psychology course. Clinical was the first course I've ever received an A+ in.

Dr. Gillespie was such a sweet women. She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed in her class. Her lectures are just her reading off the slides, but she makes it interesting. Her exams are based on study guides and you are allowed to skip 5. Although you are only graded on 5 exams the class is not too hard! Love her and the class!
Sweetest professor. Material is fairly easy and digestible and she is always open to answering questions. She says you need the textbook but you don't. Show up and you'll pass.

She is a great professor. Class had 5 tests and thats all. If you pay attention in class and listen to examples she gives you'll do fine on the test. She also gives very very detailed study guide for each test. You can only fail if you decide you want to.

I took clinical & community psych with her & they were very different. In clinical, your grade was based on all tests, but in community, there were 2 big tests (midterm/final), 3 small/easy papers, and a final term paper. Also, she took attendance in community and not in clinical. Her lectures can be boring but she is such a kind soul!

Dr. Gillespie is very caring which will be clear the second you walk in class. I had her for child and clinical. She relies on power points, and you will only get graded on tests (but they are super easy if you fill out the study guides). It also helps that she is knowledgeable and passionate on the topics. Sometimes class can get boring. Easy A.
Reads from the powerpoint for the most part. Has a lot of life experience and stories to offer- class is worthwhile. Half the class stopped coming about 3 weeks in.

Currently in her community psychology class . The class is very straightforward. 4 hw assignments, 2 test(not a final on finals week), & one project paper . Shes give a 24 hr grace period on papers so still able to receive up to 24/25 pts. Buttt class isnt necessary, everything can be learned from slides but attendance is mandatory. ugh.

Shes a kind caring woman with a lot of experience in the field of psychology. She doesnt take attendance, and she posts the lectures on blackboard. You can get by with just studying the PowerPoints for the tests, but listening to her lectures will richen your experience. I personally didnt but shes a respectable woman so word up

Janet is a lovely person and really cares about making you understand her content, her lecture style just didn't work for me. She basically took information straight from the textbook and pasted it on a slide and then read the info to us, with minimal explanations. I had to reference the textbook attempt to understand what was going on in the class

comment: Very sweet lady, and definitely knows what shes talking about. The tests are mostly based on her lectures, but i found the book to be helpful. Your grade is solely based on your 5 non-cumulative tests throughout semester. Tests are 40 questions, though she lets you skip 5. You can get up to 3 points in extra credit added to your final grade.

Professor Gillespie did a good and thorough job covering material that wasn't covered in the text, but was relevant to the topic at hand (Clinical Psychology). Essays were easy if you studied and required reading the text. An easy A if you study and attend class.
tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'Caring']

comment: Professor Gillespie is one of the sweetest teachers you'll find at Brockport! Her lectures are amazing & challenging as well. I recommend taking any courses with her to get an ideal concept of what college courses should entail. Her teaching style is smooth and impeccable. Though there is a required textbook, reading her PowerPoints should suffice.
She really opened my mind to a career in clinical psychology! She is an amazing professor

Dr. Gillespie is a very sweet lady and is incredibly passionate about clinical psychology. However, if you don't plan on going into a clinical doctorate program, the course is pretty unnecessary. The book is not crucial but studying the powerpoints is. Tests are not hard.

One of the best professors at Brockport I've had thus far. Very helpful and explains material thoroughly. Very passionate about her field of work/study. If interested in Clinical Psychology, definitely take this course with her. Very kind, caring individual. Don't need the book to pass, but it was helpful sometimes when studying.

She is super energetic. Took this as a summer course.  Easy quizzes everyday.  Got to choose which quiz questions you wanted to answer.  Easiest A I have ever gotten.  I would totally take any of her courses again

Really informative lectures and as a person. Her tests are not that bad, just study the lectures really. She is enthusiastic even though some of the material she has to go over is boring. Most of it is interesting though. Very DSM-focused. Will help you a lot if you ask for it. The book was largely whatever, don't buy it.
Extremely kind and willing to help whenever you need it. One of my favorite professors.
The class is very boring but she is a nice professor. Just be prepared to re-read the powerpoints before the test. You don't need to buy the textbook.

Dr. Gillespie is a very knowledgeable, extremely approachable professor. She is passionate about the material, and helping her students gain a good grasp of the concepts. Tests are reasonable and focus mainly on content found in the power-points. I would absolutely recommend her as a professor for this or any other psych class you take!
Awesome teacher! She made a 3 hour class fun and interesting. she really cares about her students and is a huge inspiration to her students. Really recommend her as a teacher!

I took Clinical at the same time I took Abnormal and that really helped since they are both similar and sometimes one class helped me learn about a concept in the other. If you print off the powerpoint slides, come to class, and do the study guides you will get a A. She's always willing to help but class is all lecture (don't really need the book)

Dr. Gillespie is a great teacher who loves her field. She personally makes study guides for her exams, which are quite difficult if you do not review the study guide. If you are serious about actually learning the material (this doesn't mean read every chapter in the book. I never cracked it), and complete the study guide, you are guaranteed an A.

This class is a class you want to take if you are good at memorizing for tests. Don't expect the most interesting lecture, but then again, if you go its not a big deal, everything is on the ppt. DO THE STUDY GUIDE. If you do it and memorize it, an A on every test. She said she took attendance, but doesnt. Shes nice and passionate. Easy A.

I've only been taking Clinical Psych for 4 weeks now and I can't believe I haven't taken this professor before! She is the nicest, most dedicated, clear, and friendly teacher I've ever had in Psychology, and probably in my entire career at Brockport. Examples are great, tests are great, I feel encouraged to speak, she's just perfect!!! :)

Dr. Gillespie is passionate about what she teaches. She cares about her students learning and even learns their names. However, she made Clinical a very mundane class. Every bit of info is deemed "necessary" or "critical" even when it isn't. The class is primarily memorization ("What year was the Practitioner–scholar model proposed in Vail, CO?").

Had her for both clinical psych and community psych, and if you're interested in the material, you will love her. She really knows her stuff and wants you to do well. Tests are pretty difficult though, so make time to study if you're looking for an A
DO NOT join her research team as an undergrad or grad student. She is disrespectful, manipulative, and unaccountable to her students.

This teacher is not approachable at all. I clearly got a vibe that i was wasting her time. She talks over you if you have questions, and we'll brag the entire class about the famous psychologists she's met. My best naps were during this class.

I was really looking forward to clinical psych. But within a few weeks I was regretting it. All she did was read off her power points and ramble. She gives attendance so you have  to be there even though the notes are posted. Her tests were random and hard to study for, she used her notes and the text book to create the tests.

Very nice, and EXTREMELY helpful as far as learning more about the grad school process.  However, she does require you to memorize a ridiculous amount of information for tests that you'd never have to memorize otherwise, even as a psychologist.  Didn't retain much about clinical psych since all I was concerned with was cramming my brain with stuff.

DO TAKE! Seriously what more do you want out of a class than just 4 tests. No homework! No quizes! No presentations or papers! She's very helpfull, you can tell she loves what she does and she's an actual CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST. The only bad thing about the class is that it can be boring. Read the texbook, use her study guides and you'll be fine.
DO NOT TAKE!!! Tests are extremely hard, she teaches at a graduate level. You need to study for days to do well on exams. Very rude and unapproachable. Not helpful at all!!!

Hands down, Best Psych prof. at Brockport! Lectures can become boring, but she will ALWAYS take time to help ANY student. She is fair, and completely dedicated to teaching.  You will be hard pressed to find a prof. as willing to teach and help students at Brockport as she is.  No presentations or quizzes. Read the book, and you'll be fine.

She is very kind and caring while being intelligent and effective teacher (how rare!). She is very dedicated to her students and shows that by making exhaustive study guides, detailed lecture notes, and geting tests back very promptly. Would definately take another class with her.
Awesome teacher!!  May seem a little crazy at times but always happy and cares about her students very much!  Knows her stuff very well and is the best psych teacher i have ever had.
Great teacher, kind of boring sometimes but she knows her stuff.  Very very helpful and tests are very reasonable.

Shes very bubbly and keeps class as interesting as possible. She gives study guides for all 4 tests and as long as you know whats on those study guides and you go to class, you'll be fine. AWESOME TEACHER!

goes out of her way to be the most helpful she can to students. You can tell she really cares and wants you to do well. Her class has 4 tests and she gives studies guides on what to focus on. They are very helpful. Do the reading, go to class and study and you'll do well!
Very good professor, nice and interesting. No papers, projects, homework. Just 4 tests if you attend class and study the note sheets you will do good.
one boring class!!
She is wierd, but her class is okay if you attend!
This class was very easy is you attend and read the worksheets. She's busy but she's very nice and very willing to help not only with the class but also other questions (like grad school).
She was such a nice professor. The class is a little hard but her worksheets and review sheets ease the pain a little. I would recommend her!
great teacher, material is a little hard...would reccomend to anyone interested.
She is the nicest teacher I've ever had. Explains everything and gives handouts with all the notes. It's a great psych class to take.

Gillespie is the nicest, most helpful professor I've had in three years. She is a little crazy, and a little self-centered, but she is a great teacher, you don't take notes, and there is never any homework or projects. Study guide is all you need for the tests.  Must Take!
most helpful professor I've ever had!
good teacher.. her class is prolly the only one i learned anything in
kind of difficult course, but dr. gillespie is a great professor

this class is ridiculous, all you learn about is complete life histories of dead psychologists and how to give IQ tests, she is not helpful at all and i wouldn't suggest her class
The worst part of this class is you learn WAY more info than is on the test She gives you enough info for a 200 question test.

great professor,learned a lot from her class.taking her course in conjunction with other PSH course,1 course is strengthed in the other,therefore it is easier to study!to do well,work on the study and vocab sheets,lecture notes,&text,I guarantee a B! : )
spends too much talking about herself. is not so nice when you ask questions.
She is so full of herself - someone give her a cookie!  She can't teach, her lectures are contradictory to other classes, and I completely regret taking the class.
you will hear  i earned my Ph.d. at Southern Illinois University  an average of 9 times per class.

Tough but totally worth it. I would take more classes with him
He told us he understands that we are human and we have a life outside of school. He is very understanding and his class was very fun and interactive.
He's a very good teacher.

I have heard so many poor reviews of Coleman in his years at RIT and beginning years at SUNY Brockport, and I have a very opposite opinion.
Coleman is a hard working, kind, caring professor, who cares very much about his students.
If you struggle with organic, take his course, he won't leave you behind.

Dr. Coleman is a great orgo professor—clear, dedicated, and ensures you learn mechanisms if you put in the work. Weekly HW/quizzes prevent cramming. But avoid if prepping for MCAT/DAT—he skips ACS final, so you'll have to relearn ALL orgo content again in studying. Best for deep learning as he puts in the effort, not exam standardized exam prep.

I like how he explains materials, I just do not like how he runs the class. There are so many quizzes and homeworks and he frequently reuses the same problems, but he's so slow at grading that you don't get any feedback in time. So you just keep getting the same problems wrong over and over and never learn. Also take lab with Jaques, not him.

Dr. Coleman is the worst professor I have ever had the displeasure to interact with. He is an intelligent man, but that does not reflect in his lectures. He constantly is saying "wait that's not right" and proceeds to spend the next 10 minutes fixing it in lecture. Lectures are not helpful, the homework and quizzes are unnecessarily hard.

Dr. Coleman was new to the school when I took 305 with him and he came off unapproachable, but by the second semester he was much more pleasant and responsive. He really did want us to do will and gave us all the tools we needed. We had hw and a lot of quizzes, but they were nice because they helped us know exactly what to study for exams

Bring advil cause he likes to talk loud.  He is a good guy though, extremely helpful, wants everyone to pass.  He offered tons of extra credit in my class.  Tests are fair but don't think your going to do well if you dont study.  Do the assigned textbook questions and read the chapter summaries and you'll get an A

Eugene is probably the best professor I've had at Brockport. He's extremely nice and extremely helpful. The class could be challenging if you don't take notes in class, but reading the book isn't totally necessary. If you study you'll do well and he's always willing to give extra help or answer questions via email.

Super easy class! I studied with a friend about half an hour for quizzes, about an hour for tests and i got an easy A. Eugene is really nice if you talk to him a little bit before or after class. Great guy all though sometimes he gets off topic. I recommend this class!
Makes class enjoyable!

Eugene was one of my favorite professors here. Extremely funny, nice, and very knowledgable. Loves what he does and has amazing stories that will make class fly by. Exams are pretty easy, offers lots of extra credit, drops the two lowest quiz scores- he's just great. Even let me take the map quiz next week after I had studied the wrong one. Great!
Nice guy, loves what he teaches, and class is pretty easy...I got a B+ without ever studying for the Exams!
One of the best professors I have ever had. I loved going to class and learned much from his teachings!!! I strongly recommend it!!

One of the most enthusiastic profs I have had here. Willing to do anything to help. Keeps you occupied in class. Wants to see everyone do well. Cool stories, weird expressions. Take you geography with him!

Professor Gartland is nice, funny, and interesting.  He shares a lot of his life experiences, which adds a nice twist to somewhat dry material.You won't use your book - he uses power points. Just get a good atlas. Map quizzes are easy.  I got a 100 on every single one!    Highly Recommended!!

Such a great guy and very interested in what he teaches.  Don't bother buying the text book you wont use it- class is pretty easy if you study for the map quizzes and none of the tests are cumulative. If you need geography definately take it with him!!
If I could give Mr. Gartland higher than all 5's, I would. If ESC 102 is a requirement for your major, take it with him.

If I could give Gartland a 6, I would. This guy can be considered crazy...but he is so funny. You will find most of his stories interesting and laugh at his random noises and facial expressions. TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM!

If you are going to take any Geography classes take it with Gartland. He knows his stuff and makes it interesting as possible. Just study the notes from class for the test and you will do fine. You have to take map quizes which are cake and he drops the two lowest scores.
Really fun class stories make the class go by fast! study for the test all of the tests are pretty much exactally what the notes say
Such a nice guy! Knows  his stuff and tells stories that relate to the topic. Not a hard class...just study for the tests.

Class is very straightforward and Dr Kofke is very organized and laid back.  Week grace period for all assignments.  Some bigger projects will take lots of work, but she is always accessible by email. Directions are clear and lectures are engaging.  She truly wants you to learn the material and succeed in the short and long term.

She is so nice and caring. This class was group work and conversations every class which was not my fav so make sure you sit with people you don't mind talking to. Lots of assignments, easy grader and 2 big projects, offers extensions, and helps her students. Is very passionate, she is also easy to talk to. I just didn't enjoy constant group work.

I cannot say enough positive things about Dr. Underhill. She is truly one of the best professors I have ever encountered. She cares about you as student and wants you to succeed in her class. I would highly recommend her to anyone (majors and non majors). The class also had a really positive vibe. Class was easy and interesting.

I cannot say enough positive things about Dr. Underhill. She is truly one of the best professors I have ever encountered. She cares about you as student and wants you to succeed in her class. I would highly recommend her to anyone (majors and non majors). The class also had a really positive vibe and was easy and interesting.

She is a Awesome nice lady. Tests are basically open book. One group presenatation like 5 min each person. I'm pretty sure everyone does well in the class as long as you are there, awake, and do the work. Course content was also interesting and she brought in a lot of real-world experience to lecture

She is a very nice and quirky lady. Tests are basically memorization. One group presenatation and a paper from an interview. I'm pretty sure everyone does well in the class as long as you are there, awake, and do the work. Course content was also interesting and she brought in a lot of real-world experience to lecture.
nice lady..funny and interesting stories

This class is very easy and pretty boring.  Class consists of debates between teams (3 or 4 people) and several papers.  If you hate writing papers, don't take the class.  If you are a strong writer, then you will ace this class.  Be prepared to be bored though!

Dr Underhill is a great professor for adult students. Her projects are fun, exciting and keeps your interest. Her test are memorization which can be hard but you know what material is required for the test. Don't be afraid to ask questions and provide comments, she is open to other peoples experiences and opinions.
Tests were hard, but this class was fairly easy for a five week course. Dr Underhill is a good person to network with.
Class was quite easy. Alot of time spent on "Professional Portfolio", as well as presentation. Overall good professor.
Very good class, a lot of work to prepare for the final presentation. She is very knowledgable and you can learn a lot from her.
She is extrememly intelligent and totally knows her stuff. Her teaching style will only appeal to some. She welcomes challenge and is very able to be objective while playing devil's advocate.

I had Mark Chadsey for several courses and he was one of the best and most memorable instructors I ever had. He arms his students with the best resources on one side of an argument (text books) and then gets them to think critically often in juxtaposition to those resources during his lectures and discussions. A memorable professor!

the way he taught this class was LAZY. gave no opportunity for student engagement and when challenged or correct he shuts down students. Also based a large portion of the grade in a book that was irrelevant to the class

This professor has no care for his students. All he cares about is politics. We all got sent to online classes due to the virus and he would not post to blackboard and sent all lectures via email. He also took time away on our tests while we were adjusting to online classes. He grades based on 4 exams and a 2,000 word essay on an irrelevant book.
Very good professor, awesome class

Great professor. Genuinely cares about his students and loves when students come to see him for help. Classes are lecture based but the time usually goes by quick. The exams are pretty straight forward and he gives out a study guide a week before the exam. If you study and pay attention in class you will pass the exams.
Lectures are long and he has you write down a lot. The tests are hard so make sure you study and do the study guide. There is a book you have to read then write a paper on it.

Mark Chadsey is my academic advisor for political science and has been a fantastic professor. The only down side to his classes is how dense the lecture notes are. The exams are difficult but you can do well if you study and participate in class discussion. He is a fair grader and a wonderful mentor whom I will always look up to.

Chadsey was horrible, I don't know how he still has a job. Painfully long notes that he zoomed through and barely touched upon, making exams difficult. You could participate for extra credit, but it took away from copying the notes down. He barely explained anything about the final paper either and wasn't that willing to help. Avoid at all costs.
He was rather rude and could be quite demeaning at times. Offered little help when asked to clarify the topic of discussion.

I had professor Chadsey for Constitutional Law and again for American Foreign Policy at SUNY Buffalo back in the 90s. By far he was the most engaging and intelligent of any of my professors there. I learned an incredible amount from him and ended up determining that as Law School was not for me. 20 years later I still remember him!

He assumes everyone votes and cares about government. He gives 4 tests (NO study guides given) & requires participation or your grade will go down a letter. He never remembers anyones name so I am not sure how he knows who participated. Course is easy to pass as long as you write good notes and memorize everything.

Let me just say that this professor is absolutely ridiculous. I went abroad to Europe with him for a Study Abroad program and he gave almost the entire group studying about a B as our letter grade. We had to keep a journal and write a research paper for the grade. It's ridiculous that we should get anything but an A for a 2 week study abroad trip.

Professor Chadsey was a very straight forward teacher.  If you read the textbook and study your notes you will be fine for his tests.  Make sure you raise your hand and answer questions lot in class.  His class is a little tough, but he is a great professor.
Interesting man... didn't know before that Republicans are allowed to teach at Brockport. Since they are, he was hard but had hillarious lectures. If you work, you'll get a good grade.

Great guy. Very smart and it shows. Interested in class discussion and listens to his students. Two tests and one project at the end was it for grades, but if you pay attention and take notes there is no problem. Those who put in the effort definitely do well.
Chadsey is extremely confusing! Grade is only based on four tests! Test are extremely difficult, even if you do use the study guide to prepare!

Although he is a cool guy and very nice (in my opinion) he didn't know a single thing he was teaching about. This class was a history class so its understandable that he didn't know everything, but it was a let down to be taught word for word from the text book every day. Very nice guy, and very insightful about life.

Changes his mind often about what is due and when it is. Tests are hard, don't let the easiness of the first test fool you. Lectures are super boring and he plays favorites. Study guides are useless and unorganized so best to make your own.

Dr. Chadsey definitely does not like teaching lower level courses, and it shows. His study guides are so disorganized and bad. Overall, class is decent, and Dr. Chadsey contributes intelligent discussion and remains mostly neutral. The tests aren't super hard but are hard to study for because of the study guides.

Dr. Chadsey is extremely intelligent and extremely helpful. He really clarified the material and made the class fun. Brockport is lucky to have a Columbia Law Grad as a pre-law adviser, who also has a great amount of knowledge on American Politics. Great teacher, get to know him.

Chadsey is the man. Talks a lot but knows his stuff. Ridiculous amount of notes but he is a great man. Tests are based on study guides that he gives you. You just have to sort the bad study guides questions from the good ones. I have a B+ with minimal effort.
Only four tests are given in PLS 113, and that is your final grade. Teacher is nice and fun, however, the tests are extremely difficult and are not based off of the study guides.
Good Teacher Lots of nots big study guides
Good professor, if you have any interest in enjoying the class rather than enjoying yourself despite the class, it'll be good.
this class is so far the worst class i've taken during my college career. very boring. he gets off topic way too much. the amount of notes are absolutely ridiculous. do not take this class with him.
Liked to change his mind a lot.
knows his stuff about law and politics. interesting class, learned a lot.

Dr.chadsey is a very hardcore professor. He be can Intimidating at times. His three hour class will not be one where you fall asleep he expects alot from his students. He expects you to read the texts in depth. Do not skim at all and always show up to class ready to be put on the spot. He is a conservative man however he respects students with well

Dr. Chadsey can be intimidating and tough, but he can also be nice and funny, too, at times.  You will absolutely be put to work, and attendance is mandatory, but if you apply yourself, you will most definitely learn.  Outwardly conservative, but more than happy to discuss issues--he gives good grades to those who give good arguments!

Amazing professor. He is a hard ass and sarcastic. tough but very fair. Knows his stuff. Never come to class unprepared.don't think you can just skim the books, read in depth. it's very interesting class once you get used to the format. I would deffinatly take more of his classes

He is a pretty decent teachers. He is defintely a conservative but he tries to let you know that, and also tries to keep his bias out of discussion. His actual lectures are pretty boring and lots of notes for an intro class, but the tests are easy. He gives study guides that follow along with the chapters you are assigned.

Chadsey has a lot of assignments that are very difficult, the readings are long and dense and the discussions take up whole classes when we were promised time to do research.  This class is not for the faint of heart of the lazy.  But over all he is a good professor who will, if you ask nicely, reaffirm your understandings, not give you the answer.
Dr.Chadsey is a great professor he is very intelligent and will help you get a jump start on an internship. His class is very difficult and there is a lot of homework, get on his good side early

GREAT TEACHER! He makes himself available for students all the time. He is intimidating the first few classes but then you realize he is the best! Take his Intro to Legal Studies class if you are even remotely thinking about going to law school. I am a senior and have learned more in his class than any other!!!! Hes well worth the extra effort

Classes are long and boring, he has a very strong opinnion, and gives tons and tons of notes. Tests are fairly easy as long as you study more than the night before the test. Gives Extra Credit options that i needed to boost my grade.

Dr. Mark Chadsey is a cruel Hardcore Conservative that, despite his claims, incorporates his opinion into his lessons and often expects his students to accept these as fact.  His assignments are absolutely ridiculous, and yet he gets enraged when no one meets them.  He is the worst professor I have ever had.

His classes are really great, and are very interactive. Class participation mandatory. No exams, couple of research papers. Opinionated guy. You need to do the reading for the week: we had 6 chapters(ridiculous, I know) but the read was worth it. Not a walkover class, but a really interesting one if you do your homework... I love it!

Class was not hard as long as you take notes, read, and study.  Definally can pull a B+ if you just do that....  However, if you don't take notes or read or pay attention to his lectures you will be lost and never be able to pull off a good grade.
If you show up to class and take all notes he will give you the study guide for all tests and if you get them it is all in your notes... tests are a lil tuff but he is an aswsome teacher!!!

a tought teacher and kinda intimidating since he looks like a professional wrestler, but its well worth it. you get so much more out of the class. he can even be a funny guy sometimes!
He's an ok teacher, very opinionated. You either get along with him or you don't

Everyone says that Dr. Chadsey's classes are difficult, but I really don't feel that is the case.  Just DO THE READING!  Also, look up some background info. on the reading assignments and discuss it in class.  Seriously, if people just engage in an intelligent dialogue in his class, they can do well!

maybe his other classes are easy, but intro to legal study is not.  This guy is a pompous, sanctamonious hypocrite. AMAZING! BRILLIANT! HE IS THE BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD! *****
Chadsey is wicked hard...but an awesome teacher!

i dont know how anyone can say hes a hard grader. there are four multiple choice tests and thats it as far as grades go so.. chadsey is awesome. very conservative, but if you pay attention and take the notes, the tests are easy. great class great teacher!
Great teacher!! He is very clear and confident in what he is teaching you, and does not try to hide his own feelings.
Chadsey's a really great prof.  He makes his class interesting and it's pretty easy.  Really tries to be politcally neutral.

This is one of the best professors that I have had at Brockport. I would recommend this class to anyone interested, or if you would like to get an easy A. Just do the study guide that he provides for each test, and you'll do great!

class always devolves into loud debates, which he is fond of.  very hard grader.  his opinions interfere with the course material, since he'd rather talk about his feelings on contemorary issues that give a lecture.

Dr. Nishiyama is a little strict on grading, but as long as you show up to class prepared, you'll be fine. He's very funny and has a lot of really interesting stories to tell.

I really enjoyed Nishiyama's class. He is a great guy that tries to make connections with his students. As long as you're nice to him and pay attention in class you will be more than fine. Class is simple, but the papers are a little difficult because he is super strict on criteria.

Super nice guy!! Definitely recommend this course. Easy A. Allows you to retake the midterm and resubmit an essay. Only 1 test (midterm), the final is a group project. Attendance required.

comment: Dr. Nishiyama is a wonderful professor! You'll definitely  have to put some effort in, but if you take good notes, participate, and do your papers then you can do well. Amazing professor, very intelligent. Really makes you think about the world around. I feel like I had a much more unique learning experience compared to most other professors. Really cares about his students. But, he is tough teacher but that is just because he expects the best of us.

Dr. Nishiyama is a great man, a great teacher, and a great scholar. He is incredibly particular in how he wants responses to questions in writing. Best advice, be prepared to work as hard as you can and talk to others who have taken his classes previously. Also, be ready to learn. This guy brings his A game. One of the only real college professors at brock, Dr. Nishiyama is wasting his potential. He should be somewhere much more prestigious. You will become a better student by being in his class. A hard grader but he is nice overall. I don't mind having him in a different history class later.

Pretty difficult grader, even for a 300 level course. Sometimes his grading just doesn't make sense as well and he  seems to expect way too much on the papers. Course itself isn't too difficult and he gives a lot of bonus points if you do the work. Course objectives pretty clear mostly. Take this class if you have to get that Asian requirement done

Nice Prof. but very difficult grader. He definitely does not treat the class like a 100 level class. Material is straight forward, but his level of grading is ridiculous. I had 400 level classes easier than this class. Good luck.

Overall he's a good professor. He gives out study guides with important points that will be on the quizzes. You need to read the text book in order to find certain information that will be on tests. he likes to give about 5 quizes in which he gives all the info but u will have to read the textbook it is key to passing the class.But he is very funny and extremly helpful. Good professor. Extremely enjoying this class! recommend to anyone.

Great teacher! He is extremely organized and you will definatly know what to expect on all quizzes and exams. Be aware: he makes you work, which means he will get you out of your comfort zone. He knows what he is talking about and he is extremely helpful. I worked hard and got what I had paid for at Brockport.

treats an intro level course like a graduate level, horrible!

andrew is by far the best criminal justice professor at Brockport, he truly knows what he is talking about. a textbook is required but i didnt use it at all you just have to pay attention in lectures. his tests are easy and he doesnt try and trick you at all. attendance isnt required just pay attention and youll do fine.

comment: She was the professor for the Brockport Internship Program. She seems nice but lovely, and IS an easy grader but for some reason she picks and chooses grudges. There aren't too many assignments to complete, and she offers extra credit. It's not hard to do well in this class, but the lectures are not very interesting or engaging. Study hard for the tests - there are only 2 throughout the semester, and the study/reading guides are very helpful.

Professor Orr gives long boring lectures that can sometimes be  hard to understand. 2 tests a midterm and final. You must also turn in 5 news articles with reviews that go along with the weeks topic (you choose topic)

Professor Orr is such a sweet woman but is too smart for her own good. She asks if we all understand and when nobody says anything moves on extremely quickly. Her quizzes were online for my class so there are a lot of points to make up. Overall would recommend her classes.

I recommend taking research methods with Dr.Orr. She's great! It's a difficult course but she is very good at explaining the material. I'm sad that I just graduated because she's one of the best professors at Brockport. I would have loved to take more classes with her!

Dr. Orr is one of the best and nicest professors at Brockport! Her classes are discussion based and she makes heavy use of essay based assessment. She is very understanding and provides awesome feedback on your writing. I definitely recommend taking her; she is absolutely brilliant and you will learn a ton in her class.
Didn't learn a ton, but the class was easy and not boring. Dr. Orr was very nice and tried to be very helpful. Would take more classes with her.

Such a sweet lady. And her accent is adorable. Really understanding; always doing things to boost your grade-- whether through your participation or attendance. I was supposed to get a B+ in the class, but she gave me an A- because I was there every day. But I also took the class in the summer, so, I think it was a bit easier then.
She's hot!  I love her!!
great professor. not an easy class, but definitely manageable and she is understanding so long as you show effort
I love Professor Orr! And, it probably helps that she's my advisor, lol.

dr orr is a lovely woman  ilove her accent anyone concerned that she is going to be biased need not wory you can ceartainly see where she stands on issues but she welcomes all well thought out arguments and seems to enjoy a spirited debate extremly helpful and caring great teacher seriously take her classes

Dr. James is the best teacher that I have had here at Brockport.  She is very helpful in and outside of class. I go to her for everything. She is one of those teachers that truly cares how well her students do in class and in life.

Probably one of the best combinations of lecture and real world experience professors you'll get. He knows his stuff inside and out, and is willing to answer or expand on non textbook related issues or questions.

He is probably one of the best Accounting professors at Brockport. He knows his stuff, and he teaches it in the best way possible so that is broken down, and simple. There are 3 tests and a project. Very straight to the point professor, and cares about his students
Awesome professor and really knows his stuff.  Do the homework and read the text and you will do fine.  Down to earth.  I recommend him to any business student.

if you don't do well in this course, its totally on you. you have to work but hes always - yes always - willing to help.

I've never struggled with any class in college more than this one. To be fair, he knew his stuff, and was great with office hours. Lectures- fast paced, he forgets that students don't know chemistry like he does and talks over your head.   Office hours- always in his office, tends to ramble off topic.  Will throughly explain answers to your questions, til you understand.  Expects that you will have read and have some working knowledge of topic before you ask questions.

Prof. Heitz is a very knowledgeable man but not a great teacher. He was a pretty decent guy, was easy to talk to, actually cared about how you do despite his demeanor in class. If you talk to him and approach him for help, he'll be there for you. Think you were good at highschool chem? think again. Hetiz goes insanely fast and puts things on the tests that aren't even in the book. Good Luck.

Heitz is very distant. I had to teach my self everything I would have faild had I not had a good chemistry background. His lectures are very confusing. Long Mastering Chemistry assignment assigned very often, not fun and hard. Over all I  would not recommend him.

If you are not good in math and need constant direction this is not the class for you. Heitz knows his chemistry, however he is by far the worst person to teach this subject.  He has an open door policy but makes you feel small when asking for help. If you need Chem to graduate take another professor. Oh mastering chem is also a pain.

Funny guy if you have any sense of humor at all. Just talk to him hes very logical but does a really good job explaining when you need help and more than understanding if you have any issues with classes or life. Take his class but get ready to work, Analytical chem gave me a challenge and kicked my interest in chemistry into high gear.

I felt as though he was very degrading to his class and was not willing to help students excel. Getting clarification on many of the topics we covered was almost impossible and I had to seek other help. I don't recommend him.
He was very generous with his time when it came to asking questions at his office and through emails. I think he does his job well.

I found Heitz easy to get hold of if needed.  I liked how he re-ordered the text so that each week we just built on what was learned before. This class took up most of my time just to keep a passing grade.
I felt he talked down to the class and/or students at times.  He is helpful, but based on the way he talks to you- you may not want to go back and ask for help again.

Goes through material rather quickly, but it sure is understandable when you read the textbook! (We're in college now kids). If you ask questions he'll explain it, so speak up if you're confused. He rushed through all the material in lecture then would immediately give you homework online that couldn't be completed because you couldn't even understand what he was talking about in lecture. Rushes through everything and is very confusing. Very hard tests. Very rude when I went to his office hours. Would not recomend
Hard class but Dr Heitz is always there for help. I came away with a new appreciation for chemistry.

Very rushed. Tests were hard, but he gave partial credit which boosted my grades on them. Final was ridiculously hard. Labs were easy but boring and long.
Didnt think he was a good teacher. Always rushing. Gets to lectures late a lot. Need to keep up with owl assignments. Was an unorganized teacher.
Very rushed. Hard exams and final exam was ridiculously hard. I dreaded lab because it was so tedious. He is a nice guy and helps you when needed though!

Extremely intelligent and hard-working. If your not a hard worker and don't test you're limits you probably won't like him. I would strongly recommend office hours he can help you so much. Take advantage of the help. =]
At times very discouraging with the way he speaks to the class. Rather passionate about chemistry. Office hours are very helpful, though he may seem intemedating. OWL and lab are key to success.

I really liked Dr. Heitz. He definitely helps you if you seek him out for it. The class was not easy, but thanks to him and along with independent study, I did quite well. Do your OWLS as they help a lot and study alone many hours a week in order to succeed in this class
best professor ever.  very helpful.  expects you to do the work but is willing to meet you halfway if you're having trouble.

Heitz was amazing! The lectures were long and boring, half of the time I spent texting. However, if you do the owls you will be successful. After taking AP Chem and getting  a 2 on that exam this class was wonderful. I had the background knowledge but this just further cleared things up. He is a good professor, enjoys the topic and teaching it. As a lab professor he helps you out without giving answers away.

Hietz does an ok job teaching, he just creeps me out. He puts his leg on the seat in front of you and flexes. It's really creepy. The class is pretty straightforward and clear though. he's a good prof and a funny guy to have lab with

good guy!  tries really hard to work with us to help us learn.  you gotta put in the effort but he's always there to help.

comment: Professor Fellner gives clear direction and clear grading criteria. He grades promptly. Keep an open mind when reading the syllabus. It may seem overwhelming in the beginning but his assignments are fun and creative. He assigns writings that allow you to be creative.

As a writer, I really appreciated his class. He threw creative and challenging assignments at us that I loved. my favorite example is the one where we had to use only two lines of dialogue -no more, no less. He's a tough critic, which is needed for writing. He takes fresh take on creative writing that was very fun to play around with.

The professor can be hostile sometimes. That's the only way of putting it. It's his way or no way. The classes can be interesting and you can learn a lot, but expect rude comments. Please, for the sake of your mental health, do NOT take any of Fellner's classes. Professor Kerfoot is a nice lady and will accommodate your needs however, she gives out an extreme amount of homework that just isn't reasonable. comment: I had to drop this course because of how difficult she made it. She cancelled class once a week, never communicated, and our assigned textbook was a grammar book that we had to answer questions about. There were always 7-10 questions, and I would have over 3 pages of writing just for homeworks. Incredibly boring and a harsh grader.

I have never had a worse professor than Kerfoot. She graded everything late. Posted things late. Didnt answer questions. Great professor! Take advantage of the rough drafts (if offered). They are really helpful and she gives amazing feedback. My class was all conversation based, no lectures which was cool. Dr. Kerfoot is one of the sweetest women in the English department, which is saying something considering most of the professors are so awesome. She is extremely kind and thoughtful idk what most people on here are talking about. Yes she grades a little tough and can get off but COMMUNICATE or use office hrs and you'll improve your papers. Kerfoot was the worst professor I EVER had. She's unclear in her instruction & is very unfair in her grading. I most definitely would not recommend taking any class taught by Kerfoot. She grades with a ridiculously nitpicky rubric and is under the impression that only her opinion is the correct one.

She has unreasonable expectations for her classes. This is supposed to be an introduction class, but she teaches it like a 400 level. Really great professor, he's extremely knowledgeable on what he teaches and makes lectures interesting. Doesn't really respond to emails though and the essay lengths are a bit excessive for a 100 level course. Don't take if you're looking for an easy class to fill space, but it's interesting

Fun and kind professor. Class is HEAVY on writing but as long as you put in the effort and have a general understanding you will do decently. Overall a nice guy and decent class. Super interesting guy.. he seems incredibly knowledgeable.
a literal saint and so understanding. a lot of reading and lectures weren't very easy to listen to

comment: Dr Davila was a truly great professor,very clear presentations in class,i enjoyed going to his class,just make sure you read any related readings

Davila is a pretty nice and passionate professor. He cares a lot about history and makes it known through lecture's . Show up to class or give friend your iclicker, fill out the outlines every week because they're on the test, don't bother reading textbook just read primary documents, do all of the primary essay's, and rack up points on quiz day's.

Dr. Davila is a great guy. Lectures are super engaging and he gets the class going with his hilarious jokes. He's so passionate about history and is willing to help. There are 3 unit tests and 4 papers that you use readings for, so not hard at all. He gives outlines of notes and he gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. Overall, great teacher.

This cat is authentic! The real deal! Scholarly? Check! Commanding? Youbetcha! Eccentric? In spades, my friend! Funny? To be sure! Reasonable? But of course! Fair? I'll say! Passionate about the subject matter? Like, for sure! Engaging? Say no more! Presidential? Let's not get carried away....

Dr. Davila really prepared for this class and it showed. The Silk Roads were presented like an epic story with a beginning, middle, and end. Very engaging classes. comment: Davila's a very cool guy. He's very funny, and if you agree with his political beliefs you'll get along with him very easily. Kind of crazy, but in a good way. He can seem crazy at some points but is very down to earth and realistic about topics.  He keeps things interesting in lectures with sarcastic comments.  Lots of essays and reading but not too hard of a grader.  Good teacher overall.

He is a brilliant scholar, yet still manages to stay personable. His lectures are very funny, interesting and engaging. I'm never bored. That said, you will have to work hard to pass. BUT if you meet the challenge, you will learn much more than in the average classroom. Warning: There are a lot of readings and you MUST read to pass!

Great professor. He lectures every class, and the lectures are the basis to the essays you write in class. He is eccentric, in a good way, and keeps class interesting. VERY interesting class, but at times you will find yourself second and third guessing your work beucase you don't know what he really wants to see. Keep an open mind, very important.

Class was interesting but you must have an open mind. Dan is very chill to the point of unclear sometimes. Everything is open to interpretation. You basically grade yourself.  There are some assignments like journal entries and reflection papers and one large group project at the end.

Dan's the man!!! I loved this class, the only class at Brockport that doesnt feel like a class. It's really interesting and he doesnt give exams, which is great. Online discussion fourums a couple of weeks, reflection papers, journals and a group presentation. Overall, great class. loved it

The class itself was alright, but dates are always changing and instructions are vague. Dan is a very difficult grader for someone who tells us to be open minded and "let go of your ego". TAKE this class! It is easy, and very useful for anyone.
SO EASY!! Take it with Mykins! He's the man!!
SO easy it's almost too easy. Fun and interesting class.
taking this class for fun, not even in my major. if you're not opened mind don't take this class...I love it

Worst professor ever!

Rehnuma is a really nice person, but kind of boring professor. Her class isn't too hard - take notes and you'll do fine.  Tests are open book. Projects are pretty easy. She just takes a long time to get to the point.
She does not speak English very well and has a hard time explaining things. She was very nice and an easy class but you dont get your stuff back and she takes a while to grade stuff

Dr. Karim's class is not the most interesting, but she does well with the content. As the tests are open notes and book, it can span a great deal of information. Not an easy A but well earned. This professor is a strict grader with confusing instructions on the assignments.  All of the tests and quizzes are open book which is very nice.

Rehnuma is a little bit hard to understand at times but she does her best to make herself understandable to everyone. If you need her to clarify, ask her and she will do so. She's very nice and makes all of the class information relevant and interesting. She's great!
She helps us to relate the topics with real life. Assignments allows you to undestand the topic better. Need to covercontents and maybe that is why the contents could be borng at 8am :)
really boring class. hard to stay awake for the 8 am class. easy if you do all in class assignments and homework. tests are open note open book.
Interesting person but not an interesting teacher. Same thing everyday! Not clear about due dates or expectations. She is very understanding though.

Helpful. Listens and generate discussions on the topics. She includes examples and youtube video which are very helpful to understand the content. The one minute papers are helpful to reflect on what we learned that day.
I enjoyed the class and learned alot about whats going on in the rest of the world. Her examples make things easy to understand.
She is very understanding when you approach her but her classes can be a little boring. Open book tests. You cannot make up work that you missed in class. You need to be able to do group work.
He reads from the powerpoint, he always tried to cover a lot of chapters in 1 test.

Prof. Eldridge gives a real world view of law and tells it like it is. He was also great in connecting me with an awesome internship. Does not actually teach, just watch videos and podcasts. Only way to learn the material is if you do all the reading and do what ever you have to do to learn it. I myself will not take him again. Boring class and does not actually teach you anything, that's it.

Very good professor.
Ida was a tough grader. She gave way to much home work. She was very aggressive and class always went to the last second possible.
Prof is great. She is like a mother to us
This woman is my savior. she is the best teacher I have ever had in my entire life and so insparational. She is so helpful with assignments and is a very funny woman.
i loved her

Ms. Wilder is a nice lady but for a 111 course you simply need for credit she is rough.  Tons of homework. Don't take this class, save yourself.

I had a lot going on when I took this class and he worked with me every step of the way. If you're clearly making an effort to learn and do the work he will help you in every way he can. he gives you the direction to receive a good grade. He gives you multiple opportunities for points as well. Great instructor overall

He is a funny guy, and tries to make the class fun. If you don't put in the work you wont pass. Its easy to get a good grade in this class if you show up and do the work. As long as you give him attention and respect he will give it back to you.

find someone else
avoid at all cost
Great teacher and role model!  Dan Raimondo is easily the greatest teacher I have ever had.  Awesome guy.
My favorite teacher ever Mr. Raimondo is awesome

Pr. Meeuf is one of the best professors I've ever had! He's a great teacher and he's hilarious. He genuinely cares about his students. However, he's leaving after this semester so no one else will have him.

Dr. Heavey knows her stuff. Shes an amazing professor. Do the work and youll understand Stastics by the end of the semester. Lectures are great, the text book is great. Clear and concise. Lots of work and worth it.
She is very organized .  Expects a lot from her students but supplies you with the knowledge to be prepared and do well in her class..
Took Epi and Stats. She is very thorough and very nice.  One of the best instructors at Brockport.
Interesting, lots of good application activities, understands adult learners, would take ANY class she teaches in a heart beat!

She's a sweet professor. Gets VERY behind on grading. Quizzes from beginning of semester still not graded and we are going into May now. Quiz every week. The material is HARD , so your best effort will need to be put in. Lab is also a lot of work.

Lecture wont make sense if you just attend and take notes. You need to put in time outside of class or you absolutely will not pass. Don't expect to get anything back graded on time. From mid-semester break until the end of the semester she did not upload ANY grades, and tests took a long time to get back graded.

Great professor. Explains topics and answers questions VERY clearly. Very approachable. Funny in class. TERRIBLY disorganized. Late to every lecture and she doesn't update blackboard fast enough. But her lectures are interesting and definitely easy to retain information the way she teaches.

Smith is a very nice and caring person. The class material is not easy but it is manageable if you study and pay attention. She knows how to explain things well and answers questions when asked. comment: Professor Smith is always super kind and very helpful. It was difficult material, but she explained it very well and boosted my confidence in learning chemistry. I'm not sure where the negative reviews are coming from; the tests and quizzes where fair and she was always available to meet.

Very nice person & great Lab Prof. Doesn't teach well during lectures, and has given class the wrong info on multiple occasions. Short quizzes and tests impact grade a lot. MUST buy the homework access, but the text isn't needed.
Few tests. Can't teach, can't answer questions, can't stay organized. Not a good professor. Homework is extremely difficult.

She's extremely disorganized, odds are if you set up an appointment with her she won't show, and will NOT respond to your emails for at least a week. She is very nice, but a bad prof.

Dr. Smith is very unorganized. She fails to respond to many emails from and takes weeks to respond to ones that she does. She does not answer questions when people ask in class. The lecture grades are mostly based on four tests and a few quizzes which are short so getting one question wrong can ruin you. If possible avoid her class.

The class in challenging and the exams are extremely short so if you get one or two questions wrong your grade will suffer by a lot. Her teaching stile is not too bad and she does give online homework and quizzes per chapter, and clicker questions in class.
Dr. Smith is the best chemistry professor I've had. She explains things clear and simply. She really cares if students do well and is so easy to talk to. Never makes you feel dumb.

Prof. Smith is a good teacher. The content was not hard to understand and as long as you stay on top of your work you'll be fine. You also do not need the textbook. All hw, tests, quizzes, and project are online, and you have to buy the textbook on Pearson. She makes an effort to help students understand and you can easily get a good grade if you put in a little effort.
She is hard to understand but you can learn most of the material on your own when doing the homework. Extremely nice lady and will do her best to help you learn.

Professor Zhou is extremely nice and there to help you in every step. I truly learned a lot in the class and she were always available for help if I needed it. Slight language barrier, but did gave lots of examples with clear logical explanations in class. I would definitely take her course again!

Has a VERY heavy accent and talks extremely quickly. Quiz/Exam days there was no class bc its online. Will curve a TON. Bonus pts for attendance participation cut project work. I passed with an A by studying 5 hours a week but you can pass with min amt of work due to how much she curves I guess. Wouldn't recommend unless if there's no other choice
Very rude, mean.... AVOID AT ALL COSTS

Dr. C is a pretty good teacher if you like to be actively engaged. There is a good size Midterm and Final Paper, but if you're one who can stay organized and ask questions, you'll be fine. Don't be too discouraged if she gives harsh feedback, she does it to everyone.
