comment: Probably the worst part about this class is that she does a lot of powerpoint lecture and there's no real connection between the book, the lecture, and how you get graded on the paper. The paper it's not clear how you are supposed to write it and then you think you're okay but she gives you a low grade with no feedback. Lectures are boring.

I really love her as a professor. She is extremely knowledgeable on social justice issues and social work in general. I always leave class feeling like I've learned many new things. There is a lot of reading, but it really does help on the tests.
tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Tough grader']

comment: Dr.C is amazing and very knowledgeable about what she does and teaches. I highly recommend choosing her as a professor if you want someone who has real world examples on top of a fun yet educational class.

IF YOU TAKE THE CHAPTER QUIZZES AND STUDY THEM YOU WILL PASS THE TEST! Dr. C has an awesome personality and is very fair. Be on time and do not miss a class unless you have a note. 10/10 would take her as a prof again. She is a woman to look up to.

Dr. C is fair, challenging, and funny. If you don't like to read, you will struggle. Don't wait until the last minute to read or study. I needed to be fully engaged with the materiel to earn my grade.

Dr. C is the best professor I have had at Brockport. She is an excellent model of social work ethics and really cares about the material that she is presenting. She does make you work for the grade, but she is always available during office hours for assistance. I cannot wait to take more classes with her!

Dr C is an asset to the profession and to the college at Brockport.  She challenges students to exceed their individual level and offers support and assistance every step of the way.  She models social work ethics, if your looking for easy, go  find another professor.  It your looking for competence in the field this is the professor you want.

Very rude, refuses to help students with questions about the assignment. You don't know if your going to pass the class or not, how she grades you isn't clear. All she does is stand and talk at you the whole time.

Dr. C does her best to make sure her students are learning the material. She sticks to the rubrics when it comes to papers. She informs her students of worldly issues and is an exemplary social worker.
Dr. C was so helping in the adjustment into college. I can not wait to have her a social work prof. In the upcoming years!
Dr. Moe was very disorganized and the class was confusing.
If this class wasn't required I wouldn't have taken it. Moe is all over the place. The class was always lost and we were way behind. His assignments were confusing and his lectures made no sense.

Dr. Moe is an incredible professor. His class is a nice mix of lecture and interactive learning. I took his Theories of Mass Comm class, and he'd relate the topics to current issues/topics to keep us engaged. The workload is manageable, and he really cares about his students. He even stayed 30 min. after class to help me register for fall classes.

This class has a lot of easy assignments & Dr. Moe is an easy grader. I am taking the class online & the class does not receive much attention. I haven't received an updated grade since midterms which makes it difficult to determine final grade. Drop boxes for submitting work are not available until the last minute, same with assignment directions.
This class was horrible. We were required to read PowerPoint slides before class and then he would just read the slides in class. I learned nothing. It's an easy A, but it's painful.

This class was awful. Doctor Moe completely bailed out of the class and failed to provide any information. Assignments were confusing and deadlines were missing. This class was a waste of time and money.

HON380. Dr. Moe is a very patient and understanding professor! He wants us to learn and participate but doesn't force us. He shares interesting and funny stories that aren't offensive, he listens when we talk. We didn't do any meaningless work, and I feel like I learned so much! Dr. Moe is kind, respectful, and hilarious. I loved the class!

I took JRB 467: Theories of mass communication with Dr. Moe but I couldn't select it from the list. Makes me wonder why. Anyhow, perhaps the most remarkable thing about Dr. Moe is that he goes beyond the traditional bounds of teaching and provides inspiration for life and he made me realize things about myself and the world as it applies to media.

comment: I have read some previous reviews which may have misunderstood his teaching style, but I found him to be an exceptional teacher who truly cares about his students. He is incredibly smart, and I found myself learning things about the world that I never would have imagined.

I recently took HON 380: Disinformation with Dr. Moe, and I have to say that it was an incredibly enlightening and fulfilling experience. Unfortunately, I was unable to select the course on the RateMyProfessor website, which is a shame because Dr. Moe truly deserves recognition for his outstanding work.

I feel like the online class is forgotten about... Sometimes I forget about it because we hardly hear from him. He doesn't answer emails, he doesn't update grades. comment: There are some very harsh reviews here and I don't think he deserves them. One mentioned the syllabus was outdated, which does seem to be true. But he is a very easy professor and the workload is very manageable. I will say it does sort of seem like he forgets about this online course, as grades are not kept up on, but he still reaches out.

I love Dr. Moe. He is one of the most understanding and compassionate professors I've ever had. If you do your work you will be successful. A lot of students think that they should be successful just based on his lectures and do not do any work out of class, but then blame that on Moe. He is a really great prof

Professor Moe was all over the place this semester. The class was not organized at all. Syllabus was outdated so none of the dates were accurate. Then all of a sudden you would have a paper in two days, but it was never assigned. He is so hard to reach outside of class, but his assignments are pretty easy. Class content is interesting. Bad prof.

comment: I'm taking this class online, and it really feels like he forgets us half the time. Weeks pass without any input from him - no grades, no updates, no nothing. Professor Moe is a very good professor. He's also very understanding so he will excuse you, if you have other important in school things to attend to. There's not too many assigments for the year, but when there is, he's a pretty easy grader. There's only two tests, the mid term and final exam. Study the material he provides and you'll be fine.

comment: Dr. Moe is a funny guy and makes his classes and discussions interesting. His tests can be a bit hard. Not a lot of graded assignments. Big group project for grade at end of course.

Professor Lewis is the type of teacher I hope to be in the future, the kind to be truthful at all times, the kind to work with you in the classroom and outside of it. Honestly an inspiration, I enjoyed class a lot. This class felt more personal than others, because of Professor Lewis but also the subject and the way it was taught. 10/10 recommend.

I took two classes with Meredith, and I understand that her teaching style might not be what works for everyone, but it worked well for me. Lots of energy, really made the class feel the weight of importance that it has. Extremely friendly, willing to help if you ask for help with specific sections, and pushes you to dig deeper for the answers.

LAZY! An online class with her consists of many readings, doing assignments based upon them, and completing a culminating assignment you're given zero direction on. Your assignments will sit ungraded for the whole semester and never be looked over. Final grades were always late, too. She puts no effort into anything and obviously does not care.

Absolutely useless. Does not provide timely responses to students, check in during the semester, or give feedback on assignments. Professors should be doing all of those in online courses. Her final grades were always late and she submitted them without grading specific assignments. You don't learn much because she makes no effort to teach you.

You do a lot of busywork, including Google Classroom assignments. The assignments aren't difficult, but you don't learn much. The lesson plans are mostly done on your own with input from other students, rather than the professor. The class is very involved with politics but not much actual history is covered.
Daisuke is a chill and funny professor that keeps students engaged. If you show up to class, you will have no problem getting an A.

Good course , it's required for the geology major. I learned quite a bit but the professor is very harsh at times and your grade in the course will entirely depend on how often you can come into office hours alone since noone in the classroom apart from him will understand what to do on the homework. If you're a commuter goodluck.

comment: 4 exams, attendance + labs make up the grades. Classtime is exclusively lectures. Uses Top Hat (a paid service) for exams and attendance. Lectures are kinda boring and I found it hard to retain information. Gives questions for exams to study. Not a bad class, but not recommended if not interested in science. Friendly and kind professor overall

Super easy class. Grading consists of attendance and quizzes. Every class is a lecture that he just reads off of. He gives you the possible quiz questions a week before the quiz, so you know most of the answers before you start it. Sometimes it's hard to understand him, but the majority of the time his English was good.

Very annoying that I had to pay for an online service in order to participate in lectures in class, and he did not offer any alternatives. We also took all lecture exams on this service and it was really inconvenient at the beginning of the semester. Other than that, the class is easy enough if you show up and take notes.

He's a great guy & really tries to help you learn, for most concepts he has a visual aid or an analogy to help you understand like bringing in a lava lamp to explain hotspots. Uses tophat which you have to pay for but no textbook. Study guides are literally the test questions, easy labs and will help you if you need it. Good guy, good yellow crocs

Class is pretty straight forward. Watch the lecture videos, take notes, take a 1 question quiz (which is a easy 100 with 2 try's as well). 4 exams, all with study guides that are EXACT questions that will be on the test. Take notes and use the online textbook and you will have every answer. Very clear on due dates, etc. Class is fun and an easy A.

comment: I wish I had a better time in his class. not only did i struggle but the test questions were confusing and not in our area. there were several questions that we did NOT learn. he was so sweet honestly, just not a great teacher.
Amazing guy. So dedicated to his students. Available almost 24/7. So funny. One of my favorite professors of all time.

comment: One of the laziest professors I have ever had, and I have multiple degrees. Lectrures one thing but tests on material that is completely different. Expects you to teach yourself the lab material. When it comes time for your lab practical, more than half the students bomb it with a 65 or below.

Hes the best professor ever, hes really understanding, easy lectures only time class is mandatory is for group work, you have 3 chances with quiz, if you dont get an A in this class its probably cause you aint look at the slides he posted he always posts the slides! No excuses! Hes hilarious and trys his hardest to make class interesting and funny
Daisuke. Kobayashi. What a man. Would rate higher if I only could.
Great professor, and very laid back. Participation through TopHat is crucial, and there is extra credit through the final project. Quizzes were online and open book. Easy A if you apply yourself.

Casey is one of the easiest, laid-back Professors I have had. He uses TopHat, where you do not actually have to be in the classroom to get the participation points for the day if you do not want to go. Try to go once or twice a week and you'll be fine. Quizzes are not super easy. Study for those. He is super nice and cares about content!!
Great teacher

This is the second class ive taken from Casey, love this dude, so understanding, willing to work with you when you're having trouble, always responds to emails quickly 10/10 would recommend taking his classes
You cannot fail his class unless you're trying to, so understanding of personal situations and always willing to help students out
He's a great teacher, very easy class and it's quite interesting at least to me. I would highly recommend for easy credit.

comment: Casey is the best professor I ever had at Brockport. He knows his stuff and is very passionate about it. I'll always appreciate what he has done for the students and I, especially when the program seemed to be dying. When my research project seemed to have met dead ends, he always went above and beyond to cater to my needs and give motivation!

Dr. Griffin is a great addition to Brockport meteorology and brings a new revitalization to the department, and has great experience with weather software, coding, and researching. The labs are very fun and useful, and teaches us coding, data collection and analyzing of weather data. It is good experience for real world applications.

Dr. Keating is a kind prof who cares about his students. However there is no engagement with the classes and he just lectures. There were two essays throughout the semester. Lots of extra credit op. YOU DO NOT NEED THE TEXTBOOK, he provides an online one. Easy A for sure just show up to class for the grade.

Prof Keating is a nice man, but his classes are the same lecture heavy slides every time. When I emailed him I did not get a response, and he is not very tech savvy either. Saying that, he does care about his job and loves anthropolgy, but I personally did not love the class.

prof keating is a pretty average professor, its clear hes very passionate about anthropology and i like his personality his class was just kind of boring. but the tests were all online and everything, only 2 papers

He talks a lot but he is really passionate so if you like the topic you will like the class. I don't recommend classes that are over 50 minutes though because it is very lecture heavy and can get boring as the semester goes on.
doesn't know how to use technology whatsoever
Get ready to read long books :D I can barely understand what the author is saying most of the time

comment: I loved his class. He gave clear understandings about what we were going through and I found this class very interesting. You will need to keep up either through the text book or the slides.

comment: He is an insanely chill guy. Cannot respond to an email to save his life, but in class, he is always ready to discuss and is never rude/mean. People complain he is biased in his opinions, but many of them never challenged him to see how he would respond. Pretty easy class, just some tests/quizzes and a couple papers that you always have time for.

Dr. Keating is a great Professor. This class challenges you to think about recent global human rights issues. It requires dense reading and writing, so be prepared for a couple 10 page exams and a 10+ page research paper. Lectures can be a bit boring, but attendance is mandatory. Part of the grade is participation - so show up.
Happens to share opinion frequently-clear political bias and the lectures are horribly boring. Monotone voice over disinteresting topics. Wouldnt take this class.

comment: Hes a nice guy but he doesnt teach anything you cant learn on your own. He tells you to read a chapter then goes over the chapter in class and thats how every single class is. Tests are hard but grades essays lightly.
tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LECTURE HEAVY']

comment: This is a great course if you're interested in the content that the professor is teaching. Professor Keating is really dedicated to his work which may cause him to discuss topics that differ from the readings he assigns but he always attempts to find a distinct connection between the two. Lots of dry readings but overall, interesting lectures.

For being the head of the department he is very unorganized and does not manage his time well. Be prepared to be kept in class five+ minutes after the class time is supposed to be over. He can make any topic that is interesting into a boring topic.

He means well but the class was terrible. Boring lectures and really hard tests. Long boring readings for very class, everyone in the class struggles hard.  I took for a humanities credit to bring up my GPA and it was the worst decision I have ever made. not recommended.

He's a miserable teacher.  He doesn't know how to teach. The course could have been great but rather he spent 90% of the time talking about current events and not give us any background on any of the movements or what human rights even are. I feel I went into the class with more knowledge then he had. I would avoid him at all costs.

Dr. Keating fails completely at guiding his student through his course. the class time is often spent speaking about current events or some contemporary matter, and the text he assigns is absolutely god awful, at least for his human rights course. No in class explanation of the reading, and over 200pg of reading are assigned for the final exam.
This theory class is very difficult and not very clear in objective or material. Extremely smart professor though.

Dr. Keating has a real passion for his material, and is very devoted to his work outside of the class as well. Brings his experiences to class, ample time for open discussion on the topics in class. Political ecology course has been great as it covers current issues. Relaxed, but very focused. Highly recommend to anyone serious abt his topics.

I would rather funnel a bottle of liquor then take this class again. He means so well but he just cant teach. Lectures are boring, tests are impossible unless you stay up all night studying because he doesn't give out the study guide in enough time. Just absolutely awful. Never again... NO

Dr. Keating seems to care deeply about his students and his courses. He makes a real effort to enhance the scholarship of his students, which is especially pronounced when you go to him for assistance. I have taken several classes with him and I've always appreciated that he respected my ideas and drive to explore questions in a creative manner.

He is  good looking, cool personality too and that makes the class really pleasant. Can't stress enough how important it is to read the assigned reading... If you're not planning to read the course material, you probably will score poorly in this class.

Pretty boring guy, fairly easy class. Gives 3 papers, only 2 main tests (midterm & final) and a good amount of extra credit. He posts his notes before some classes which includes the clicker questions so you could look up the answers in the book. Online quizzes were fairly easy. Walked out with a B+

The material covered is challenging, but nothing to worry about if you take smart notes when doing the readings before class. He offers opportunity for a healthy amount of discussion...An easy prof. to communicate with. I have always enjoyed his classes. A strong effort is required to do fairly well (A,B),but you will learn your stuff.
His class wasn't too bad. Offers extra credit, and is helpful if you email him. Online quizzes were kind of difficult even after reading the textbook. But, overall the class wasn't too horrible.

NEVER TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM. IF YOU ARE FORCED 2 YOU NEED TO BACK OUT NOW! YOU LEARN NOTHING AND HE TESTS ON THINGS YOU'VE NEVER TALKED ABOUT. EVEN THE MOST DEVOTED STUDENTS HATED HIS CLASS. YOU WILL LITERALLY WANT TO GET HIT BY A CAR BY THE END OF ONE OF HIS LECTURES.

His class is actually not all that difficult. It's a real class, wow...don't get too many of those. I often feel that undergrad classes are too easy. He's a good teacher, and he helped me out a lot when I went to office hours for research help. I  liked his personality. He's a cool guy, very real and intelligent.
Makes interesting topics worse then going to the dentist. I will never again take a class with this man
Good guy, knows his stuff. You just have to read the book before the class and you will understand his lectures. He actually challenges you to think for yourself. I learned a lot from his class.

This is the THIRD class I have taken with this man; 2 undergrad and this grad class.I've just failed the last two, based on the SAME subject matter. After three years, I still cannot keep up with him. He is a brilliant scholar and is knowledge unimpeachable. Granted, I have my academic difficulties. Unless you can devote 100% to the class, don't.
Do not take this class. It was far too difficult for a 100 level course and the research paper was awful. He didn't clarify a thing and gave very vague instructions. He is a hard grader too.
He gives lectures every class unless syllabus says group work. But even then it is basically all him talking based on chapter by chapter.  You have to read the chapter or your lost.

Hard Teacher. Avoid him if you want a good grade. He knows his stuff and is really mellow but he just can't teach at an undergrad level. He tries but he just can't teach. He's more for graduate students not undergrad. Avoid!

This class was something I took just to fill a humanities gen ed. and it turned out to be my most difficult.  The readings were boring the tests impossible and it is guaranteed to bring down your gpa.  Nice guy, but needs to seriously rethink the meaning of a 100 class
No Comments

Avoid this class at all costs. Research paper was horrible, he didn't clarify or explain anything. Tests on things he mentioned for a few seconds in class if any. Way too much work for a 100 level class.

He knows his stuff.  But by the end of the semester, he's still the only one who knows his stuff.  His reaching style is awful, bland powerpoints that dont help you at all.  The reading is dry and boring.  His test questions come right out of the book from random sentences.  You only have 2 exams and a research project for grades.  Unfair.

I loved this class with Dan. He truly cares about the well-being of his students. I took this class as a night class, and we were only there for about an hour and a half. He really wants his students to learn about their own mental health. Put in effort into the assignments and you get a good grade.

He is absolutely amazing. He always tries his best to help other students despite being busy all the time which I appreciate immensely. Easy class just show up for attendance and do all the required work for the class and you will get an A.

Dan is probably the best professor I've had. He is hilarious and understands that college is stressful. Always willing to help, helped me out with my other classes as well. Always emails back fast. Doesn't make you waste money on books. Actually cares about his students, goes the extra mile to help out. Definitely would recommend taking his class.

This is probably the best professor ive ever had, you cant fail unless you dont do the assignments or quizzes, but they arent difficult if you pay attention to him in class which isnr difficult because he makes class fun and hilarious! Need more teachers like him!

One of the nicest professors youll ever meet. Actually cares about what you have to say and is really knowledgeable about what he teaches. Super funny, always is making jokes about his bummy appearance. Attendence isnt really mandatory, but youll come to enjoy going to his class

Awesome Professor, you actually learn the important things of the field and not information that is unnecessary. He understands that you have more to life than being dragged down with tons of work that you won't even remember. I wish I could take all my classes with him!

Kandris is AWESOME!!! His class is sooooo easy and its a lot of fun! He is also a really easy grader and cares more about his students trying rather then grading based off of right/wrong answers. In this class, your opinion cant be wrong. As long as you show up to class, complete your assignments and attend the counseling sessions, you'll get an A
Just really a great teacher. Funny and down to earth. Least stressful class you'll ever take.

Dan is an awesome teacher! There is no textbook, he gives you all the powerpoints at the beginning of the semester and he goes over those in class. You never have to take notes. All the quizzes are extremely easy, all directly out of the notes. He is so wise and has such a positive outlook on life, take this class!!! Easy A, and he's hilarious!

one of my favorite teachers I have ever had. His quizes are right from the notes he gives. you dont need to buy the book. the group project is super easy. the final paper is super easy. He just grades you on doing the work and the work is not hard. he cares about his students and his students future. Take his class if you can, hes great!

Dan is an awesome guy! The class is more of a class about life than just about counseling. He's super helpful with anything, even things unrelated to the class - loves to help resumes and interviews. The mandatory counseling sessions are also good life experience. Also a VERY easy A.

Dan is amazing in more ways than one. Even if counseling is not your field of interest, I highly suggest taking this class. You grow both personally and professionally by attending counseling sessions, which are required by the class. Dan is open to helping his students in anyway they need, including looking over resumes and writing letters of rec.
I had Dan for my first semester of college and he is just an overall great person. Even if you're not in a health science major, I recommend taking Intro to Counseling with him. He's amazing.

class is well prepared and thought out. He encourages participation and is easy to approach when help is needed. His quizzes and test are fair. Would definitely take his class again and recommend it to others!

Great professor I have taken two classes with him so far and will be taking more. Lectures can be quite interesting and humorous as well. I have a Spanish minor and a STEM major and he's very gracious with making compromises to accommodate my conflicting schedules. Its very obvious that he cares the most about the success of his students
Amazing professor. Really cares and wants you to learn, you just have to participate and do the work. If he knows you are putting in the effort he will work with you and you will do well.
Has a decently thick accent which is tough to decipher on occasion but he is a good professor and is understanding.

This class is a glorified book club. You'll pass the class easily if you read, and speak in his class but he is extremely opinionated, he will be off putting and ignore any further discussion you give off. His dislike for what he disagrees with is very clear. I'm in the major and he's difficult to deal with. Avoid if you don't need his courses.

Professor Souto had great communication throughout the course.  Responds to questions quickly and thoroughly.  I took the class during the summer term.  Class was challenging, and everything was done online.  It was a lot to learn in a short time.  Would have liked to have a textbook to refer to.

Attendance isn't strict, but participation is crucial. He heavily grades on speaking, so you can attend every class and still fail if you don't contribute. Classes feel repetitive, like a discussion-based book club. Despite being the Spanish advisor, there's little focus on actually improving Spanish skills.
Professor didn't teach much, only had online modules each week. Modules were easy but ineffective at teaching, especially for material on the final.

This class was so hard for me and I'm a Spanish speaker, but he was so helpful. Not the best at responding to emails, but literally will work with you in every way. He really cares and just wants you to learn. He doesn't care about grades or tests, he just wants you to do the work, participate, study, and leave the rest to him. Likes to joke!
This was supposed to be a beginner Spanish class but he assumed everyone in the class had taken Spanish in High School. Do not recommend class unless you have experience with Spanish.

He is an amazing man and teacher. He is very experienced with teaching and will give you help, extensions, and slack if you ask. He expects you to study on your own and know grammar pretty well so be sure you are able to articulate your thoughts so he can evaluate just your writing. Great class!

Ismael is one of my favorite professors. He has a great sense of humor and above all wants his students to succeed. He makes you work for your grade, but he is always encouraging and available to help. In SPN 350, you'll debate controversial topics. Don't hide your feelings- Ismael is great at respecting everyone's views and opinions.

I had him for GEP100. The class was boring yet helpful. He did make it better with his accent no gonna lie. It's just very soothing to listen to for 50 mins. I have no idea what he's like when teaching Spanish but he definitely seems pretty cool.
If you can't take the heat, don't take the class! Ismael speaks his mind and isn't afraid to get snippy. He's a native Spanish speaker so he does grade rather harshly on grammar.

He is a really good professor. He really cares about his students learning and will help anyone who asks for help. Make sure to  do the practice exams, they come in handy.( some questions may pop up on the tests from the practice exams)
He is a great professor who even has humor. He is always willing to help and truly does care about his students understanding the material.

The class itself is easy. The material in class learned is very easy to understand, but his tests are very difficult. He also grades harshly for presentations and speeches, but he offers extra credit opportunities throughout the semester. You have to work very hard to get an A in this class.

Dan Harber took his own Chapyer 6 pre-test in one of our classes because he'd received feedback from the 50% of the class who DIDN'T withdraw that we wanted to do more hands on learning. He spent 75% of class doing it as we watched only to receive a 37% on the test. He then spent the remainder of the class explaining why he was right.

Constant uncertainty of due dates. Syllabus wasnt given until half way through the semester, which had zero test, homework, or project due dates. Time was not managed well and was unable to cover all of the material in class. I personally believe there is too much content that is expected to be memorized, making this class a little ridiculous.

comment: Great professor, super nice and helpful.

For intro to accounting, he's not the worst but one thing that I liked was he gave out review forms for students to rate him and give advice on what he can do as a professor to help the class out. That helped a TON and as for the excel assignments he goes over all of them so make sure you come to class as 75% of the class usually didn't.

Honestly, this professor was terrible. All he did was read straight from the e-book txt (that you need to purchase w/ the online homework). Very dull, and boring. Attendance is not mandatory, but on Fridays he usually went over the homework before its due so I would try to go. If you have the option to take this class with someone else. Do it.

Sarah is very sweet and a good teacher. make sure you're taking thorough notes on the slides and the art pieces she shows. she does a few vocab quizzes that were pretty easy. I would like it if I was more interested in the topics but it was okay

Sarah was a great professor and I really enjoyed her class and lectures. A lot of papers but easy grader

comment: I was dreading World Art II because I am not a history person at all, however, Sarah made the class easy and enjoyable. We had 1 page papers due almost every week but if you took good notes in class, or used the textbook they were a breeze. She is more than happy to help you improve your writing style and in turn raise your grades.

Sarah is very passionate about art but isn't very inspiring herself. She expects you to read chapters before class and remember all the information for lecture. If you didn't understand the textbook prepare to be lost in class cause it's all discussion, no real teaching. And the workload is a little too extensive for a 200 level course.

Extremely nice, well articulated. She does have you write quite a few papers, at least one a week, but they are mostly only one page long and are easy to do. Always gives good feedback on your writing, though some of her assignments were vague, and could have used some more clarity. Overall, great professor, great class.

Sarah makes lectures interesting and easier to understand. Unlike most teachers, she assigns mostly writing assignments. As long as you put in a little effort, it's hard not to get a good grade in this class.

Professor at Genesee Comunity College. She requires 3 pages every week (oh yeah in 10 font) along with discussion, quiz , and final paper of 5 pages. Clearly she has no life. Only take her if you love to write about art. She unfare if you so much work but takes forever to grade back your work.

Sarah is AMAZING. She is super personable and easy to talk to. Her grading criteria is clearly laid out in rubric form for every assignment and she gives ample time to get work done. Ballard is very understanding, she is very clear on what she's teaching about. A lot of useful information and the load of the work is dry bearable.

Professor Lipko-Speed is such an amazing professor and person! She genuinely cares about you and how you are doing in class and outside as well. She keeps you engaged and eager to learn! I looked forward to going to her class all day and wished i could continue and take more classes with her!

comment: Professor Lipko-Speed is very knowledgeable. She explains information in a clear way with many examples, diagrams and videos. Studying is essential, but if you do you will pass.

Super easy class and amazing lady.  Minimal amounts of studying and work and she keeps class interesting with many examples. She's always willing to go out of her way to help students.  I would recommend any class with her.

Hands down the best professor I have ever had. Uses examples, very clear requirements, realistic assignments and requirements, not too much to physically hand in. Tells you what will be on the test. one of the best professors ive had. very clear objectives, very helpful. lectures are concise, and at times she makes associations or gives examples which make things very clear to understand. definitely a great professor. cares about her students. mandatory attendance

Dr. Lipko is great. I've had her for two classes, and being a psych major she definately keeps me interested. Her tests are completely fair, you just need to study and pay attention in class. Prof. Lipko is a VERY good teacher. Her classes are interesting and well worth while. She presents information in a way that is very easy to understand and is very clear. Tests are not hard if ou study for them. Great professor

This was my second class with Dr. Margolin. Her lecture style is somewhat straightforward but she welcomes questions and her feedback is helpful. Her criteria for written assignments is vague--be sure to read instructions very carefully. Use the materials she gives (PPT's and study guide) and read the book and you'll do great.

Grading criteria did not match up for what was expected every assignment. Very very lecture heavy. As a typical A student, this class was extremely difficult, even for just a B. Not worth the time, try a different professor and spare yourself.
tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LECTURE HEAVY']

comment: Prof Margolin is a tough grader. She has strict rubrics by which she grades papers but doesn't let the class know what's expected beyond the general assignment instructions. Her lectures are clear and understandable, but there's little to no expounding on concepts to ensure understanding unless someones asks. Don't skip class if you can avoid it.

Professor Margolin is a wonderful teacher. She is notable for how difficult her tests are and how lectures are somewhat heavy in content. Brace yourself for group projects - she's also known for that too. If you're looking for a challenge, by all means, take any courses with Margolin because she is a tyrant. A very nice but peculiar one.

Margolin is a tough grader. Writing assignments need to be note to the fullest extent for good grade. Lectures are hard and confusing! If you skip class you will most likely fall behind on test (which are also very hard). There is no book or references to chapters, just her powerpoints. Group Blog at the end of the year but no extra credit options!
tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'GROUP PROJECTS']

comment: She cancelled about 75% of the classes but still expected us to know everything for the test, she is a tough grader you basically have to memorize every single thing in the powerpoints and in the book. Her study guides are no help because all she does is list every single thing. Don't take her unless you absolutely have to!

Dr. Margolin is super nice, but this class is boring. Her tests are hard, but doable. She is always willing to answer questions and takes the time for you. Be prepared for a group project that lasts the whole semester.

Dr. Margolin instruction methods are peculiar. Writing assignments require explicit detail or you will fail miserably. Her tests are confusing and complicated. She provides minimal feedback and at times will not respond to e-mails. You can either wait for another instructor to teach your desired course or register early for better options.

Dr. Margolin's grading is solely based on tests & she grades  hard.  Don't count on assignments to bring your grade up.  Even with tutoring, I failed her class.  If you email her with concerns, she will email back but just blow it off.  She doesn't care if the class is having difficulty.  It appears all she wants is to get paid to do her research.

If I were you i would stay away from her. Shes one of those professors who still expects you to be in class when its a major snow storm outside. Basically the only thing that counts is the hard exams she makes you do so the group projects and quizzes are a waste of time because it doesn't help your average.

Very difficult teacher to learn from. I do not recommend taking a course with her. Seems to be a bit rude whenever you ask a question. Horrible grading feedback. Never returned exams to see the questions you got wrong or gave feedback on writing assignments. Young, inexperienced professor. Worst Psychology professor thus far.

Definitely not an easy class but that's majorly due to the content of the material. Dr Margolin does her best to be helpful and is very responsive to emails. Her lectures are very clear and she does a good job of explaining complex concepts. That said they're not the most exciting lectures. Be aware that YOU have to put in a lot of the work

Dr Margolin is a very nice person. That being said, her teaching style isn't for everyone. You have to read the textbook to fully understand. She does try to teach it in class, but unfortunately she only teaches from her power points.

If you are a lazy student, don't take one of her classes. I liked her a lot better for Psych of aging than cognitive, I think she works better with smaller classes. She tries to make boring material interesting. I think she's helpful. If you want an easy A, she isn't the professor. However, and A is achievable and you learn a lot if you work at it

Very robotic personality,  anytime I asked tried to talk to her in her office, it felt like she was reading off a script . Her lectures are very dry, she just reads straight from the power point.  Her study guides don't cover much of what is actually on the test at all. Would not recommend.

Dr. Margolin is a very good at teaching difficult material. There are 4 tests, 4 writing assignments (done in class), a group blog, and 10 attendance quizzes. The study guides have everything that will be on the test. I didn't use the textbook at all. Attend class and do study guides thoroughly to do well.

Took research methods, sensation & perception, and cognitive psych with her. Research methods is a bit hard but she provides you all the sources to get an A. I have never received below an 85 on any of her tests but this takes studying many hours. The test outlines she gives are veryyyy relevant to the exams. Study them and you'll do fine! Writing assignments are easy as well if you have the notes filled out. Never read my books and got 2 As and an A- in research.

This class was very difficult. She gives you packets and packets of lectures that don't make any sense and are not helpful for studying. The class was horrible to sit through. I don't recommend this class.
Dr. Margolin was always good with clarifying material and worked well with all students issues and was very pleasant. Her tests were challenging but never misleading. I retained alot of information.

Seems like an easy class till you do the writing assignments and tests. She expects you to write down exact definitions or she doesn't understand what you are saying. She wants you to practically copy the textbook, but then on the multiple choice tests she expects you to know each definition inside and out. Impossible grader.

Took Sensation/ Perception and Psych of Aging. Spent most of both classes sleeping. Margolin is an ineffective lecturer. Dull and not good at conveying information. Discourages hand-writing notes. Tests are fairly tough but not a problem if you prepare beforehand. Wouldn't recommend taking a class with her.

This was one of the hardest psych classes i've taken. I only recommend this class if you are into biopsych type classes. Theres 3 tests, 10 pop quizzes (so attendance is basically mandatory) and 3 lab group assignments. Class is extremely boring and the tests are not easy, she says they get easier but they don't.
Not a very effective teacher. I really didn't like her style at all. I don't recommend this class.

For a Cognitive Psych professor, she does a poor job at effective ways of getting material into Long Term Memory. Each class was miserable. Her teaching methods seem to assume that we have some background in Cognitive Psych. Maybe she would do better teaching in a Ph.D. program for Cognitive Psych. NOT UNDERGRADUATE

I DO NOT recommend Conitive Psychology unless you are in a Master's program or have a high interest level. Powerpoints were vary vague, and the book did not fully backup the Powerpoints and ovrall wasnt helpfull. For how specific the tests were, she was very vague with the lecture..I love Psychology, but this class put a bad taste in my mouth.

I highly recommend her for Psych Research Methods... it's easy and you learn how to actually DO a real research paper, unlike in the other classes. What I learned with her helped me with all my other psych classes and now I'm a research assistant. An easy A if you do the work.

Class is composed of 4 multiple choice tests, 4 written assignments, 10 attendance quizzes, and a review project. Her tests are very detail specific, you need to know things inside and out. And her grading is impossible. She takes off points and is very reluctant to give any sort of explanation. She does give a decent amount of ex credit.

The subject matter in S&P is tough--so try to take biopsych b4 you take this class--but she makes it CRYSTAL CLEAR and give you all the info you need in class. She really makes it accessible and can be entertaining. But yes, you do have to read the book.

do NOT take this professor. she grades things way too hard, i got a B in the class when i am usually an A student. When she talks she is hard to understand and talks to us like we are 5. She laughs at her own jokes which are not funny. If you go to talk to her for help she looks at you like she doesnt understand engligh. Unhelpful! Horrible!!

Ridiculously detail-specific class. Had I known how the class would pan out, I wouldn't have taken it. Powerpoints are long and rushed through in order to get all of the information crammed in. Tests are fair as long as you study your butt off.

The class is based on tests and writing assignments. Tests are ridiculous, all application questions, really need to think . Writing assignments are done in class and graded hard. Forget about extra credit, rarely given. I got A's in all my other PSH classes and for some reason I can't even get in the B range in this one. Would not recommend her.

She really does expect you to read the book (I don't, and I have a B+) but there's a companion website to the book she doesn't tell you about, but is helpful if your smart enough to look for it. (*Most textbooks have a companion website now-a-days*) She's an ok teacher, very quirky, but she has a tendency to stand in front of the projector.

good class, only for majors. lots of info. need to read entire book and know class notes (approx. 8-10 notebook pages per class). all ques. on tests mult. choice, but they're all application questions (i.e., thinking questions). 10 quizzes per semester for attendance purposes, so if you skip class, you'll end up missing quizzes and final avg points

We're about 3 weeks in and seriously I don't think I've learned much at all, all the comments below are right and I think she is crazy. She assigned 4 essays in 1 week, and even wants us to cite HER LECTURES. You should never need to cite lectures...you're supposed to learn from them and remember what is taught in lectures, not cite it in an essay.

We are nearly done with week 2, and she has not even begun to teach us about early American history. She spent a whole class learning peoples names, amd another class going over "schools of thought" for history and then ANOTHER going over assignment formats and grammar. She has said nothing about the topic that we are paying her to teach. AVOID HER CLASS AT ALL COSTS!!!

HORRIBLE Teacher!! VERY BORING... I fell asleep in class more than once. She stops a lot in between what she is saying and never gets her point across. Only good thing about her is that she is a nice person when you personally get to know her. TERRIBLE CLASS

She knows what she is talking about but puts emphasis on the wrong subjects. She ALWAYS stares at the ceiling, so you can pretty much do anything. No tests, only out of class essays straight out of the book. Easy- but dreadfully boring.

She is seriously horrible. She has no idea what it is she is talking about, and if she thinks you are cheating, she will screw you over, even with no proof.  She forgets everything she says, DO NOT TAKE ANYTHING WITH HER.

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. If you see her name on your schedule change imediatly, dont even test run it for a week. She has no idea what she is talking about, lectures are awful. Only good thing is everything is take home. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS
LOT OF WRITING ASSIGNMENTS, FIVE TAKE HOME TESTS (ALL ESSAY FORM), VERY BORING CLASS, CLASS LECTURES ARE HARD TO FOLLOW. EASY

I feel like she is a good person and knows the material well but she is NOT a good teacher. 90% of the class is teaching yourself online through HOURS of homework every night. Ive never had so much homework. Not many people knew what they were doing. She is an extremely picky grader. She also didnt care about outside circumstances.

She's a pretty clear and fair grader, and is relatively nice. However there is just so much online homework. In class there is a lot of partner work and speaking out loud which gives me so much anxiety.

This professor is extremely uptight and difficult to speak to. It causes tension when a student should be seeking help. I ended up dropping the Spanish program just bc I couldnt fathom having to take more classes with her. 10/10 DONT RECOMMEND

comment: Lots of online work and independent learning. I suggest getting a tutor for more Spanish exposure.

This class was alright if you like Spanish. But there is a lot of work to be done outside of class. It is expected that you teach yourself everything and come to class to just practice what you learned. Professor didn't really add anything to the class.

I clciked 363 but I have taken a few classes with her. Linville is knowledgeable about her field of study, and seems to genuinely enjoy what she teaches. Some of the texts that are used are boring and lectures can be a little bland, but just keep up on them and you should be fine. Tests also can make or break your grade. Otherwise she is a gem.

Prof. Linville was a good professor. Sometimes there are assignments that she won't remind you about, but it's college, just read the syllabus or check your Blackboard account. She's extremely kind and if you're going through something she's sympathetic to that. She gives great feedback and cares about your success.

comment: I am a Spanish major and therefore have had Linville in various levels from 212 and up. Her objectives for each class period are not clear nor are her objectives for the class as a whole. She allows personal opinions to affect how she teaches individuals. A tough grader and not very sympathetic.
tags: ['Tough Grader', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tests are tough']

comment: I took college Spanish in high school but did not pay for the credit so Im taking the same course here at Brockport. She is the worst teacher I have this year. She gives an insane amount of homework and very little inclass instruction. She gives a days notice before a quiz or a test and we never have a set unit that we are working on.
tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK']

comment: This was my first foreign language class taken at Brockport and I was blown away by the lack of IN-CLASS instruction! You were essentially expected to learn the lesson on your own and simply attended class to get participation points. This would have been better as an online class, I really struggled to earn the grade that I did. Try another prof.

SO MUCH READING. Seriously, if you're one of those students who thinks they can not do the readings and rely on others to answer, you will fail. That being said, if you do the readings carefully, and are able to participate, she will love you and grade you so much easier. She will sit there and wait for an answer to her question, not just answer it

Definitely one of my favorite professors this semester. She had a very clear syllabus that she followed. She would hand back our papers with marks all over them, but with relatively good grades. The marks would just show us what we needed to improve on. When needing helping outside of class, she was very helpful.

Amazing Professor!If you need help just ask. She is more than willing to take the time to explaine and makes herself available outside of class. She takes an active intereste in student success, but she still makes you work for it. I have learned so much from her. Strongly recommend her to those who want to learn. She is a true gem of a professor.

Linville has a bed rep because of a few people who probably do nothing outside of class and still expect to do well. Her syllabus and what she wants are extremely clear, and most of the homework is very simple. Long reading assignments are, at the time, annoying, however my vocab has expanded greatly. Great professor, you will learn a lot!

I am currently taking my second class with this professor, I didn't really like her my first class but she's actually a pretty awesome professor. I was struggling with this current class and asked for help outside of class. She's willing to help students but you still have to work for your grade. She's definitely not as bad as people make her seem.

She is a nice teacher but her class is kinda boring. Relatively easy to pass if you just go to class and participate and do your homework. Shes happy to help if you need it and uses English once in a while if you really cant understand her.

i thought Linville was great. it was a little hard getting used to almost all Spanish speaking, but she helped you a lot and reexplained things. Once in a while we got some English.If you do the homework and prepare for the midterm and final, you should be fine. Linville didn't seem harsh at all. She was really nice, and funny, too!

She seems to be fair in the grading that we receive. If you ask for help she will help you. Homework assignments are very easy. She doesn't assign extra credit but she gives you outside opportunities to improve your Spanish skills.

I think people are being way too harsh about her personality, either that or she's gotten a lot nicer lately! That said, the classes she teaches are entirely based on homework, and there is always lots. She takes no excuses for late work or homework that isn't typed, and there's no extra credit, but she's definitely not the hardest teacher I've had

Good class. Good teacher. I heard comments before taking class from students who didn't think much of her teaching. I saw that the ones complaining were the ones who didn't do the work. Lazy people always complain about the teacher. She was good. Class was well thought out, interesting. Teacher was helpful.

Ok here's the deal, she is an incredibly hard teacher and a lot of people don't like her because they don't like the material being taught. This class was Hispanic World and was daily discussions about politics, history, news, current events, controversies, etc. Very hard class, but I expanded my vocabulary so much and I'm glad I took the class

Heartless, unfriendly, cold and ugly. She never helps her students and if you do not help yourself in this BORING, crapy class you will FAIL. The most boring class ever. Epic fail with this horrible human being. What a horrible person.

My least productive times at Brockport have been spent in 2 required classes 'taught' by Dr. Linville. Classwork is hw from the night before. If it wasn't for the hw, there would be nothing in class, ie, she does not teach, merely asks the class for the answers to hw q's. You will not expand your knowledge in her classes. Span dep worst professor.

This teacher sucks big time. She is very unfriendly and mean to her students. Her clothes are from the last century and her shoes are very prehistoric. I would give her an D+ on personality, teaching style and by being unfriendly and men to her students. She would do things to make you feel like crap in the classroom. God luck to all of you.

She is the worst professor we've ever had. It is 4 in the morning and we are still studying for her test because we couldn't understand anything she said in class. She is very unfriendly and doesn't try to connect with the students, look up the definition of fail in the dictionary and you will see a picture of Rachel Linville.

She's smart and not as cold as she seems. With that being said, she's a horrible teacher. She refuses to explain anything even when no one (native speakers included) understands. Sure, if you live in her office, maybe you'll get something out of it, but her job is to TEACH (aka help students understand) during class - and that doesn't happen.
She's a bit hard to understand in the classroom, but one on one she's awesome! She is very accommodating and likes to help if you put effort into it. She's very organized as well.
Far too much homework! thank god that class is over!

No extra credit :(  class time passes quickly because of all the group work, hard to figure out assignments because she never speaks in english. Lots of homework, and 5 compositions. She got better as the semester went on, but a tough teacher overall.

Honestly, I've had worse teachers than Linville. I dont think she's unfriendly, she just doesn't seem to be able to relate to students. The only bad part is that she refuses to explain things in English even when the entire class doesn't understand. She's a fair grader. Too much groupwork.You may not taking her, but you'll survive, and you'll pass.

She is awful. She is very hard to understand, and never explains what she talks about. She is not friendly and never smiles. She looks afraid at all times, and is never organized. She doesn't follow the syllabus and gives way too much homework without explaining it. I wouldn't recommend her...only take her class if you really have to!!

She does not believe in extra credit assignments.  Very difficult to understand and not helpful at teaching.  She tells not teaches and explains.  Can't wait for a semester with another good spanish professor.
Great professor, syllabus was clear and accurate.  Enjoyed the class.
While the coursework is very interesting and in depth, she tends to be unresponsive.

comment: Just another online professor who posts the slide show notes without explanations. Lengthy weekly projects which take hours to complete for only a tiny percentage of your grade. Also if you're thinking of taking this as an elective, just look elsewhere, there's much easier courses to turn to.
I took this class online and it was fairly easy. Lots of group projects and a quiz every module. Just keep up on the workload, and pay attention to due dates because she does not take late work.

I had a very positive experience with Prof Hughes-Smith. She has such an enthusiastic demeanor, and gives amazing feedback! Prof was also very helpful and available when I had questions. The class was interesting and relevant.
tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Clear grading criteria']

comment: Awesome ! Her environmental class sounds boring but, it's not. It is super informative and really gets your mind thinking about health disparities. Her modules are long and there is usually 3-4 assignments in one. Most assignments consist of watching a video and giving a reflection. Stay on top of the module and make meaningufl discussion post.
tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', 'Clear grading criteria']

comment: One of the easiest courses I have ever taken and I am getting ready to graduate in two weeks. A very nice lady with clear instructions that are easy to follow. Plus, all assignments are current and interesting which makes it easy to pay attention and get assignments done. By far one of the best professors I have ever had. Also, a very easy grader.

Easiest course I've ever taken in my life and I'm a senior in college. Not only that but she even offered a 10 point extra credit assignment!!!! As long as you do the work it's impossible to get a bad grade!

She is not clear with assignments or due dates. Module can say one day, but she takes it down and different dates and does not give you the chance to make up the work. Lots of long videos to watch and lengthy papers to write (even though she does not state it).

Professor Smith is simply amazing. She cares about her students and you have a lot of time to complete what she assigns. Plus, it's all very interesting. She's a really easy grader so you just have to try to get a good grade.

She is so sweet and so passionate about her job! online weekly quizzes on the textbook reading. Grades easy but assigns a good amount of work. One project presentation at the end of the semester. Gives you the opportunity of extra credit which helps your grade a ton if you decide to do it. Overall easy class and I would recommend it to anyone!

THE sweetest professor on campus. She feels so passionately about the environment and her class. She shows lots of documentaries but all related to the class and all of them very good. She explains her exams very well and grades fairly on all assignments. If you get less than a B in this class, it's your own fault because she's more than fair.

In class you watch videos and read articles and get in groups then discuss them. Theres online quizzes that are timed, usually only 10 Q's. You read two books and have a open note quiz on them. The final is a paper connecting the two books and other sources on a topic of choice. night class usually went till 9. I missed 4 total and still got a A-.

The lectures are long and boring, mainly because it's a night class. She's a very sweet lady though. She assigns two books that must be read in order to write a paper; luckily the books were actually interesting.
this was beyond the most best and easiest class you can take. One of my favorite teachers
Great teacher. Only complaint is that she is NOT clear with directions and her expectations.

The way she teaches is not like a traditional way. There are a couple books you have to read but it's really not bad. There are also several quizzes on the chapters out of the textbook . Overall, she is a great teacher, knows her stuff,  and I would recommend this class to anyone interested in learning about the environment.

The class itself was pretty interesting, there is a lot of reading involved (2 novels and several chapters of the textbook), as well as some in class reading of articles. She is always willing to answer questions on the material. There wasn't much homework, other than the reading, and not many tests either. She speaks quietly, so sit close!
She explained the material thoroughly by utilizing You-tube videos.

Professor Susan was amazing. She is very passionate and I learned so much in her class. She is a fair grader and is lenient on deadlines. We watched a lot of documentaries after her lectures which helped further understanding about what we discussed. The class was down to earth and relaxing and not much outside work.

She is extremely boring and talks super quiet so sit in the front or you will be lost. She is super unclear about what she wants for her assignments and is usually confused about them herself. She is passionate about the topic though. And she grades very fairly. I do not recommend taking it as a night class though, she will go directly until 9:15

She is so nice, but her lectures are SO BORING. She will lecture, and then you watch movies/documentaries a lot. People literally got up and left during the evening class because it was football season. Project/papers are poorly defined, but she is extremely lenient with deadlines… she's boring but really nice!

I DO NOT recommend taking this class with this lady. She is VERY boring and talks just about as loud as a church mouse. She isn't clear about what she wants assignment wise, the syllabus is confusing and did I mention she is EXTREMELY boring? Also, she doesnt reply to her emails and I have yet to catch her during her listed office hours.

Extremely nice lady. Very laid back. She would teach and discus for about 30-60 mins, and then we would watch documentaries for the rest of the class. Test and quizzes were very straight forward. Striaght from the notes we she put up in class, so dont miss class. Very lenient with contents of papers which you have to write.
Horrible teacher. Don't take environmental health with her.

She is the worst Professor I have ever had. Her class was excruciatingly boring and dry. Doesn't prepare you for midterm exams at all. Mean spirited. Not very knowledgeable. Relies on documentaries to teach. Final project was completely vague and she nit picks. I do not recommend EVER taking this class with Susan Hughes. Not worth it.

I wouldn't recommend her. Take this class with someone else. She's dry and will always drag on about something just to keep you there until the last minute. She is lenient on submissions however she doesn't elaborate much on what she expects. Does not present material well for her tests.

I would agree with everyone on here for the most part. The only complaint I have is she has poor time management skills. She will lecture/present straight through for a 3 hour course without stopping for a break or offering to take a break. Some people feel rude getting up to go to the bathroom (like myself.) She needs an intermission!

A very simple course, easy A. I received over a 100 in the class. She gives out about four extra credits all worth a full 5 points added to grade! 2 midterm exams which were a little difficult, but she added extra credit to them. One essay and a group project. She's passionate, fun, and enjoyable.
Pretty simple class. Two exams which are okay if you study well. I had her once a week for three hours, which really wasn't too bad. She is fun and she loves what she does.
Easy A, watch a lot of interesting movies!! Great teacher and class she is very nice and passionate about her work :-)

Professor Hughes-Smith is very reasonable, kind, and inspiring. Her lectures are great. You watch a lot of great documentaries and read great books. I got a 100 on everything. I highly recommend this class to anyone interested!
AMAZING professor!! Highly recommend!! She is very inspiring and a lot of fun! Never a dull moment!!
Liked her a lot. She is very willing to help. Gave extentions on papers/assignments if needed. Very clear in her lectures and makes class fun.

I took 20 credits last semester, so I'm used to heavy course loads, and I've never complained and cried over anything as much as this course. She has unrealistic expectations, and refuses to assign less work when the entire class is struggling. I will never take another Spanish class at Brockport because of this class.

comment: She's not a bad professor, she just assigns way too much work. This is honestly the first time I've ever found myself complaining about a workload. Long readings for every class, a ton of papers, read a full novel in 2 weeks, an 8-15 page final, a presentation, and an interview that was due on the last day of class.

Not worth the stress! She herself was super nice but the class was way to hard for an elective that was required for many because it covered so many Gen Ed requirements. Articles assigned every class,(minimum of 10 pages to read)on top of papers she due. 2 final projects which were also too instense for an elective. 10/10 DO NOT RECOMMEND
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'LOTS OF HOMEWORK', 'SO MANY PAPERS']

comment: Great teacher. Demanding, but that's what she is supposed to do. It's college, folks. I found her extremely helpful. Actual teaching methods are very good. She is the best teacher I had a Brockport. I have no serious interest in Spanish Lit but actually got a lot out of it. A+ teacher.
Confident, intelligent, fun, perceptive.                                                                              Tons of personality.
Very mean. I used to like Spanish and wanted to make it my major, but she made me loose any interest in the language.

Dra Parada is one of my favorite professors at Brockport. She is undoubtedly the best in the Spanish department. Very thorough, good sense of humor, very human. She is also incredibly beautiful, even though she's a bit older:)

It's a rough class. She is very critical in grading written assignments and proofreading is a must. The work load piles up and she expects a lot from her students. However, Parada is a great teacher, she demands a lot because she always believes in you. Sadly I didn't make it through her class first time around, but I'm to blame for that.

My favorite professor by far, hands down. Very powerful, intimidating woman (funny, though). She is the most demanding professor I have ever had, but one of the most dedicated and helpful. Do not take her classes if you are loading on other difficult classes. If you have time and motivation to work, her classes are extremely worthwhile.

She is a very nice woman, but expects a lot from you. She is also somewhat intimidating at times. You will definitely learn A LOT in her class and you will earn her respect if you work hard. If you work hard, you'll be fine!

Super intelligent women. She def knows her stuff but she expects the same from you.  I learned a ton from her but to get a good grade in her class you need to work hard & you will gain her respect.  Always there to give help so if you are having problems GO SEE HER and it will help your grade.  I recommend her if you are up for the work!

She expects a lot but is very helpful.  She teaches you to pull stuff out of readings that you normally wouldn't see.  If you can do well in this class, you shouldn't ever have a problem writing a spanish paper again

How can you all say this??  Yes, she is a great woman and is always there to help and is very interested in student progression but seriously why dont' we tell the truth.  This woman is demanding and if you are not up for the workload, don't ever take a course with her!  But overall, yes, she is a great teacher.
Great lady...super intelligent.  She is always around to help you when you need it.  The class can be difficult if you are not advanced enough in Spanish..but overall I learned a TON!

I love her - she grades fairly, if you speak Spanish well, you get better grades, since she teaches upper level classes she isn't there to teach you simple grammar - you have to ANALYZE-was my advisor and ALWAYS there to help me

Internet asignments are unclear and a waste of time. You must be VERY interested in spanish and willing to learn the language before signing up for this class. Parada is firm, but fair and is an intelligent woman who knows what she's doing. Very nice personality and very helpful.

comment: His class is so straight forward. There are only 2 tests so you have to do well to pass. He gives you every question and every answer thoughout the semester though just have to have a good memory for the test. He's such a cool guy too!

Such a nice professor. Only two tests throughout whole course and he gives you every single question and every single answer. Such a funny guy too, and really leniant when it comes to class and class dicussions.

You're grade is based mainly on the midterm and final (35& & 35%) while the rest is "class participation" (presentation, debate). Kinda boring at times, but pretty interesting for the most part.

Marty Teller is one of the most awesome professors Ive had in my 4 years at Brockport! He sounds like King Candy from Wreck it Ralph and hes very chill. His tests are exactly what he tells us to write in class so take notes! Highly highly recommend him!

Memorization Course. All questions for midterm/final are provided- take extensive notes. 2 exams (midterm/final) 1 presentation and 1 debate. Prof is very nice & uses real-life experiences. He reminded me of a cartoon character at times. Attendance wasn't required but necessary to pass exams.

This professor is adorable. He is so helpful and literally gives you the questions to the test. The tests are short essays and short answer. All you have to do is study and memorize the questions you get and you get an easy A. Go to class in order to get an A

Crazy teacher, funny at times. But it is a lot of counsling material. It is ALL memorization. He gives the questions and answers to the test but they consist of "list 30..." Best class ever!  He is extremely helpful and tells you the actual questions on the midterm and exam--which are the only exams in the class. All questions are short answer/essay but if you have a good memory, you will be fine!  GREAT PROFESSOR!  Highly recommend him.

He is awesome!! I would recommend to anyone!! I love his class and I wish he taught more health classes on campus! Gives you the questions on the tests with the answers. Just take notes, go to class and you will pass.

Good and interesting class will do very well if you take notes in lecture. only a midterm and final and they are all short answer, basically memorize info and you will do really well, he is very nice and understanding. You could take this class just to get good grade

She is incredibly nice! If you care, she cares. Attendance is not mandatory but it is encouraged. She appreciates feedback from her students and in return likes students to actively engage. I took social media literacy and I 10/10 recommend.

She doesn't answer emails at all. Emailed her so many times and doesn't respond. She's nice but these classes are writing and research heavy. Don't know why I took the class but it is easy but alot of work.
Laura seems to really care about us. When I needed extra accommodations, she met with me outside of class for hours to help me get caught up so I wouldn't fall behind.
I loved her. She runs the social media minor and convinced me to switch because I like her classes so much. She grades fairly, and her lectures are a little unorganized but veeerrryyy fun.

This class has a lot of discussions and if the class doesn't read she lectures the class about it. She is aggressively against AI and will fail you for using it to write your papers. If you write your papers then you'll do fine, she's an easy grader and leaves a lot of feedback.

She's so much fun!! She really cares and uses slang. She feels like someone I'd be friends with and I've learned a lot from her. You have to read her assignment instructions carefully because she hides important details in them.

She was great!! She did a LOT of in-class group activities, like almost every day.  If you don't like that, you'll hate this, but it makes learning in the class way easier because you get to learn from each other all the time.

pretty cool

Jim is so sweet. Very accessible via email. His classes are entirely discussion-based, and incredibly constructive. great teacher would absolutely take any of his classes again. his expection are very clear and as long as you participate you will do good.

comment: Jim is an amazing professor; so nice and understanding. Helpful via email if necessary. I would take ENG495 every semester if I could.  The class is mostly discussion, and the papers are review-style as opposed to analytical or research. I like it! Very mechanical each week, easy to enjoy if you like reading.

comment: By far the best English professor I have encountered on the Brockport campus. Class sizes are often small which makes workshops more thorough. I left class a better writer. He is also very kind. It was always a night class I took with him and I always parked in a further lot from everyone else and he always offered to walk me to my car afterwards
He wants you to read and write better each assignment. Writing workshops > Lectures and tests everyday.

Dr. Wharton is a very sweet person. However, his classes are so simple that they are boring. If you want an easy class I recommend taking his class. However, he loves group projects and getting opinions from others. Not the best classes.

Jim is the saving grace of Brockport and I should have had him direct my thesis. He is available in his office, listens to students' opinions and concerns, and his true goal is to make students better writers. I had many discussions with him regarding life, writing, and education, and I will always remember them. He is the most personable professor

Jim is awesome! He is very helpful in class and in his office. A lot of the short stories we had us read were pretty good and it was nice that we got to workshop two stories, not only one. Group discussion is pretty interesting. Good class for writers, English majors, or anyone interested.

Jim is a great professor and a very helpful person to talk to for advice, especially about writing. His classes are all very discussion based, but it's not hard to comment on something you've read. I also liked that he graded assignments based off form and writing style, rather than what you chose to write about. TAKE HIM!!!

My GPA is 3.20. Whorton is a very personable prof. He loves to help, if asked. Classes are boring, but he has been my favorite prof. Easy class that you can get an A without doing much, besides writing countless critiques and 3 papers. I would take more classes with him.

Great guy, intelligent professor. hands down, he is the most personable professor in the english dept. Lecture is thoughtful, meaningful and with purpose.Too bad he didn't teach any of the lit. courses.

I loved Jim. I was a bit nervous to read my own writing out loud and have it critiqued but he forms a kind of family environment within the classroom so you don't feel intimidated at all. He is very understanding and kind. I didn't know this at the time but he is also an author! Check the library and read his stuff!

Horrible class to say the very least. If you are in this class as a non English major be prepared to get mediocre grades as a result. Fun class, Jim is a great professor. Very laid back, and gives good feedback on your work. Would def recommend taking fiction workshop with him.

I had professor Whorton for creative writing. He is an amazing person and a great professor. He gives constructive criticism and never makes you feel stupid. Class discussion is really important and helpful in critiquing your work. This is the only class I've ever looked forward to going to. Definitely take creative writing with him!!
Jim is a great teacher! He's very supportive and encouaging about his students' works. His critiques are useful and he gives good feedback. He's a fair grader.
Jim is a great teacher! He is very encouraging about student's work and extremely helpful in the critiquing process. He's a fair grader and gives useful feedback about your work.

His classes are easy. We didnt have a midterm! Four writing assignments all semester! He didnt teach much..but he is a nice guy. He is an extremely hard grader. He doesb't hold it against you if you miss class. If you take his class, make sure your paper is maticulous! He will take points off for every misused/mispelled thing... 6 mistakes=D+!

Dr. Zollweg was a pretty good professor, the class was super easy, you do have to do a quiz at the end of every class, but they are short and for the most part the answers are in the lectures. The only major assignment was creating a map, nothing too bad. But overall, easy class with not much work outside of it.

This class was for lab credit, so there was a lot of homework every week. The homework isn't extremely hard, but it is time-consuming. Zollweg talks during class time about the lab exercises and any upcoming assignments. The only problem I had with Zollweg is that he didn't answer some of my emails. Besides that easy class and a nice professor.

He is hilarious. ESC195 is an easy A. It could be a lot of work at times, but it is manageable. He talks a lot and no one asks questions during his lecture because he just loves to express himself. You have to pay for TopHat. There are no required textbooks. Attendance is recorded on TopHat. His lectures can be boring at times. You will not fail.

He's very easy going and will answer any question he's given. The class is honestly fairly easy as long as you study the questions throughout the slideshow and make sure to go over them for the final too.

Prof. Zollweg is an outstanding professor. He is very responsive to students' questions and is willing to help out students as much as he can. The class is online and very easy to pass, just do the weekly assignments and you're good. He is very accessible outside of class and responds well to emails. Highly recommended for an easy 'A'
