absolute worst professor I've had in my life, don't recommend to anyone at all. Horribly boring class, with tests that don't correlate with what he taught.

If you are considering taking a class with him don't. Especially ESC 195. He teaches it like a 400 level class and is one of the worst professors I've ever had. The final exam consisted of things that most of us never saw before. Avoid him and this class at all costs

comment: This class satisfies the natural science with lab credit. Go to class and write down the quiz questions - they make the quizzes and tests really easy. If you do well enough in the class you MAY be exempt from taking the final exam. The labs are really short and straightforward (less than a half hour for most). He makes it really easy to get an A.

If you are planning on taking this class for honors, don't. We had to give a presentation at scholars day, but Zollweg has no idea how to lead a team. We never had any idea what was going on and had to spend a lot of time outside of class to understand what he wanted from us. He waited until last minute to put the presentation together  stressful

Is not helpful at all- doesn't answer emails or even question asked directly to his face. Pop quizzes and labs are easy but final is impossibly hard- not an easy A. Journal and paper won't bring your grade up.

Far from an easy A. Labs are pretty easy and pop quizzes are not too bad. You have to put in a lot of work into your natural disasters journals to get a good grade. His final crushes your grade, went from an A- to a B- just because of it. Says its a lot of questions from previous quizzes but its not, only about 8 of 50 were from previous quizzes.
Don't bother trying to email him or talk to him because he does not reply. Huge year long project due at the end of the semester. Open note quizzes.

Super easy going guy.  Randomly gives out extra points to people who come. Labs are easy and the instructor gives you answers. Pop quizzes randomly. He has a very monotone voice so you'll catch yourself nodding off. Multiple choice final with a few pics you have to describe. Easy A if you actually show up. Stay on top of the disaster journal!!!!

Natural disasters is almost a joke. He gets easily confused and seems like he doesnt know what is going on half of the time, but it is definitely worth it. This class is so ridiculously easy. He gives you most of the test questions and does the lab for you. easy A, definitely take, especially if youre in honors!
He was my lab instructor for honors. Super funny, really laid back and just gave us the answers to the labs. Definitely recommend!

Overall a really easy class. The only thing I would say that I don't like about him is that he NEVER answers your emails. It's really frustrating when you have a question about the course and he doesn't answer you. But overall, an easy A.

Attendance not mandatory- though if you go there are bonus quizzes, and points go on your average. Quizzes are all with a cheat sheet. If you have a good enough grade you don't have to take the final. And a simple 1 hr lab. Easy A.

Good teacher and makes class easy and fun for the students. He is laid back and realizes we have other classes too. He's generous when grading and I'm sure he would help if you had trouble with something. He made labs SIMPLE (if you had him). Lots of helpful videos, and you get out early a lot. This guy is sooo nice and helpful!!! Tests are easy & you can even bring in a cheat sheet...very easy A...take his class!!

Natural disaster class with him is extremely easy. All tests are 40 multiple choice and are allowed to bring one big cheat sheet with you for tests. So final is just they same questions over and allowed to bring 5 cheats sheets with you. Dont even have to come to class and still get good grades.

Zollweg is a very interesting guy.  He's quite eccentric, but it made the class amusing.  It's very obvious that he is a very passionate man, although he sometimes has some trouble conveying his passion and knowledge.  He bent over backwards to appease the students, even going so far as to give out test questions beforehand.  Funny guy.

GREAT teacher. Really nice, personable, funny guy. He doesn't act like your typical college professor. I really liked ESC364 and would def recommend it.

As hard as this class is, this professor truly cares for her students. This class involves a lot of studying but do not be afraid because she is extremely accommodating and will work with you. I recommend taking this class with less classes and to study!
Dr. Rhodes is a great professor. She is willing to help but the issue is that she makes her class so unbelievably unnecessarily difficult.

Dr. Rhodes is the reason I decided to major in Public Health. She is an amazing professor. Her tests are difficult if you don't study, but if you go back through her slides all the information you need is there. I would take all my classes with Dr. Rhodes if I could.

The worst teacher I have ever had. She did not do anything except being very critical. She offered no help and did not give clear directions. So sad that she teaches mental health. And the exams were times so you have only one minute per question. Sad

Took an online class with her and it was a nightmare. EXTENSIVE amount of work given each week. Extremely difficult grader. comment: Avoid taking if possible. Tests are all short answers. Tough grading. Group project is not explained well and expects you to figure it out on your own. She has an idea of the right answer for her assignments but if you can't read her mind on what she wants you will have a hard time with this class.

She gives you way too much to do for how much credit the course is worth (3 hours). All of her tests you have to basically memorize 4 chapters of textbook info an regurgitate the information word-for-word; no multiple choice. She may be enthusiastic but she's one of those teachers who thinks her class is the only one you have.
This class is way too easy for a graduate class. Basically answers to exam questions are handed out to you before the exam. Study them and get an easy great grade.
There is something about Dr. Rhodes that is special. Her enthusiasm and passion shines brighter then the entire HLS department put together. She is by far the best professor in the department.

Professor Rhodes is very energetic. Doesn't really give homework but she gives pop quizes from the readings. Lots of group projects and assignments due at the end of the semester. Her test are short answers with some matching questions. Only take if you really need to. Can't miss class. Takes of points for grammar mistakes. Makes class hard.
She is amazing, one of best and most enthusiastic professors at Brockport! She grades tough, but she is fair! Study hard for everything and prepare to learn to public speak and present perfectly :)
Still one of my favorite teachers. Be able to apply what you learned for the tests. READ the readings. there WILL be pop quizzes. entertaining and will definatly learn something.

LOVE her! My favorite professor out of my 4 years of college. she has the great sense of humor. she is a hard teacher, but the class is not that hard. the test questions come right off the study guides, so just memorize those. a lot of group projects and strict when it comes to grammar mistakes, but overall great class!

Had her for Mental Health and Foundations same semester. She is really funny and really challenging. She sets her standards high but you actually learn from her. I enjoyed going to her class as most of them were interesting. Lots of group projects suck but SHE IS A GREAT professor, just don't be lazy

She keeps you going the whole class. She comes off as a high school like teacher but is always willing to help! Her tests are all critical thinking but if you know your material and how to apply it, they are fairly simple. Highly recommend her!
Dr Rhodes is fun and makes class interesting. The tests can be hard and pop quizes suck but otherwise its a good class and a good professor.

Took his class in 1993.  Best class and instructor I've ever had.  He is no longer with us, but has made a huge impression on so many.  Incredibly smart, master of interpersonal relationships, and a true humble person.  We all knew him for different trademarks.  During my time, he investigated the stochastic nature of "The Gizmo".  Doc is missed.

Fantastic teacher, really knows his physics, funny and passionate about his subject. Tough class though, "Physics in toys" and "101" are misleading. I've taken reagents physics in highschool and it's basically the same material, but the way he does it is on a higher level conceptually and much harder.
Very helpful as an advisor

By far the best prefessor I have ever had!! He didn't care if I knew the material, he made sure I understood it! He allowed me to love physics. He truely cares about physics and his students, and it shows! Wonderful guy! love ya doc!

He is by far the best prof at Brockport! The material is hard by nature but Doc is the most approachable person I've ever met! He helped me be successful in my dream of getting to vet school, and not by letting me slide through but by forcing me to work my tail off. This also helped to prepare me for what I am facing now at Vet school and it is just amazing! I loved Docs class and respect him more than I thought I could any person! He'll be missed if he ever leaves Bport for good. Take anything he teaches!
I only had him for advisement but he was super helpful and is such a nice guy.  I would definately reccomend taking a class with him.
physics without a calculator? ABSURD
Words can't begin to describe what an awesome teacher Doc is! He cares about the students and he truely loves physics and teaching.  Very laid back and easy to talk to. Smart guy too!
No Comments
Doc rocks the house!!  Great professor and great guy!!!  He will definately be missed!!

I've never had a class with Dr. Mancuso, but I had the opportunity to profile him for The Stylus. He's an amazing person with a lot of experiences. He's very witty also. A friend of mine has him for physics II and loves it. Everyone in the Smith Hall lounge (rm 127) loves him too. Great guy.

comment: I love Dr. Moyer! He thoroughly explains all assignments, you never have to question what he wants. He lectures great and makes sure all students are heard.

Best professor I've had at Brockport so far! I've taken a couple of his classes and plan to continue to do so. Class is very structured and he is a tough grader but you learn a lot and it's not hard as long as you put in a little effort.
One of my favorite professors at Brockport. Lays out exactly what he wants and if you follow directions for papers and do readings you will do well in both of these classes

Prof. Moyer is the best. He's funny, and he really knows his stuff. He just has a great personality. He doesn't require a textbook, but he has readings online that we have to do. DO THE READINGS. Really nice, funny guy.  Lectures are interesting.  Very tough grading, but is willing to help, if you miss class you're screwed

Dr. Moyer is very friendly and outgoing. Class is mostly reading articles and then discussing them. 3 integrative essays and 2 book reports due throughout the semester. Consistent participation in class is required.

He's a really nice guy.  The class wasn't too hard.  It was just essays and he was more than willing to look over drafts and give you tips for improvement.
Awesome teacher, enthusiastic, requires you to read for class discussions, not too much though. No test or quizzes, just 4 essays throughout the semester. Great class

Fantastic. One of the best professors i have come across. As everyone else has said, he is very demanding. I mean this in a good way though because even though his classes were a lot of work, you get so much out of them and really get a feel for the subject.

I have heard bad things about Dr. Moyer. I am glad they turned out to be untrue. Class was mostly discussions with little lecture. No tests, just a couple papers and a final research paper. Very willing to help outside of class and guide you in the right direction.
He is very, very knowledgeable.  Class consisted of reading and taking quizzes then 4 papers throughout the year.  Did not have to purchase any books which was a plus.
Interesting lectures. Funny/understanding guy, I definitely wouldn't mind a class with him as my professor again!
One of my favorite professors at Brockport.

Awesome class! Very structured. No text book to buy. A lot of article readings. No exams or quizzes. 3 response papers & 2 integrative essay papers.  Class participation is a must.  Dr. Moyer is a great prof with a good personality and does a good job of making class fun. Hes a tough grader but allows you to submit rough drafts. Highly recommended

One of Brockport's finest. Funny, down to earth, and cares for his students. One might also say he is a bit quirky, but that can be good. If you can't write essays good don't take this class that's just about all it is. Class participation counted as 15% of total grade and had random pop quizzes. He is a nice guy though.

Hes a real nice guy. Presents the information in a manner that is clear and easy to follow. Lots of reading, but for the most part its interesting reading that will really help you on papers and in lectures. Likes students to talk, A LOT! Def take him if you can.

prof moyer is a great professor- i dont like history and i really enjoyed his class. do the work and participate in class a little and you will do well, and its not too hard beacuse he makes it truely interesting. plus he really knows his stuff!

pretty cool guy, is cool to talk to in office hours too

I don't exactly know what to write here.  Not bad, not great, just.... present.  She's kind of just there... like the carpet.  No real style or personality to speak of.  It's kind of like being taught by a very smart turnip....

comment: Great professor. She is so laid back and incredibly honest. She is leaving Brockport but whoever gets her at her new school will be lucky! LOTS of reading and I found her instructions/expectations to be vague at times but overall this was a great class. I'd definitely take anything she teaches.

Naomi is a good professor, but PARTICIPATION DOES MATTER! If your a quite person and dont really like participating this is not the class for you.  There are a good amount of group projects and readings to do, but if you keep up with everything and participate you will get an A in the class.

Naomi was the best professor I've ever had. She is organized and a very interesting teacher. Unlike most professors she actually cares for her students & will do whatever she can to help. Amazing woman!
Naomi is a really awesome professor who really cares for her students.

Naomi (trust me call her Naomi, not Dr. or Miss) is a truly amazing professor. She has very specific grading requirements for her papers, but they are relatively reasonable and easy to follow. Dr. Edwards is a great professor and an all around nice guy.  His class was very easy, but I still learned a lot.  I didn't read the texts, but still received an A in the class (and, he didn't make me take the final exam).  Taking clear, concise notes is the key to doing well in his classes.

This is an extremely boring class. He just lectures the whole time and you basically have to teach yourself in order to do good. nice guy, but he is a master of talking for hours about anything not related to class-we didnt have ANY grades until after midterm, and he assigned three (3) essays on the last day of class, no joke. last day as in we wont be seeing him again since there is no final.  other than that nice guy though.  but honestly will try to avoid classes with him
He was SUPER boring...just rambled on all class.  Not funny  but tries to be. I couldn't stay awake for his NOON class! that's an issue.
if youre looking for a gen. ed for a science it might as well be this one.  curves the hell out of the tests
i've had chuck for several classes and he's hysterical and super nice, anyone who doesn't love this man is heartless!

good teacher

Very cool guy, who really knows his stuff! You'll learn a lot if you actually pay attention and *gasp* do the work!

Too hard for a 100 level class, you can bring a cheat sheet to the tests though.

The ideal teacher, mixed lecture with visual and even added in some comic relief. Perfectly clear on what he expected of students and completely fair when it came to grading. I definitely recommend this class and prof.

Great guy, very enthusiastic about the course.  Has a huge workload for the class, 5 tests and a long paper.  Doesn't review for tests, and tests are difficult.  Very hard course.

You can tell this professor loves his job. He is so excited about anthropology and just genuinely happy. He also cares for his students and is very understanding if you have to miss a test or class. The class is easy, and he makes the tests more interesting. Who thought anthropolgy could be fun?
Don't take this if all you need is a science. Very hard material, and a big bore to me. Definitely knows his stuff though. Too big of a class hurt his effectiveness I think.

Great teacher, you can tell he knows his stuff and has been doing it for a while. Read the chapters, come to class and do the project and you'll get at least a B. Also has a good sense of humor. Watch for the ape walk!
Dr. Edwards is a good teacher...he's very enthusiastic about the class, and I would definitely take another class with him.

Edwards is a big dork.  He tries to be funny and his tests are alright.  The project is bogus and the material is bland.  He doesn't get in touch with students because of the large size.  Don't take this if you care about getting a good grade - you won't.
his class is interesting. his papers are hard and meaningless. but the content of the class was good. the tests are made into movie script so they are easy to understand.
Intelligent. Interesting. Fun. Very consistent. A great scholar. Amazing person willing to help you improve. Encouraging and motivating. Cool!
A lively Professor, and different in his approach. His jokes are funny and different. Love his primate inpressions: walk and vocals. Very helpful and very, very knowledgeable.
Awesome teacher, tests are very fair, overall great guy..highly recommend him to anyone remotely interested in human evolution!
Dr.Edwards' class I found a bit challenging but it was so interesting and fun that it was worth it. I got a lot from that class and I just took it as an elective to fill a core.

great teacher, easy class, he's leniant with attendance.  take as many classes with him as possible!!!!!!

comment: He was awesome, open book exams, simple homework, easy A class if you put in the work. I can't imagine people not getting an A, A- in the course. Plus he's funny!

Daly!!! He is an amazing professor that gives very clear lectures and tries his best to help students who don't understand and he does it in the nicest possible way. Awesome professor! Makes stats so much easier to understand by giving real world examples. Literally one of the best professors I've had. Also resembles Jason Segel.

hes an awesome teacher! Take his class as your art! He's amazing and so fun to be around. No textbook but you do need to attend 3 dance recitals to pass his class that cost around $10 a piece. Go to class, for yourself and your group! He isn't the most tech savvy so try and stay on top of brightspace in his class because its not as straight forward as most other classes.

Sweet guy! He really cares about what he teaches and encourages students to try and do your best. He values those who really put in the effort to actual learn what he is teaching. He enjoys getting to know everyone. He is strict on phones, so don't be on it when he tells you not to during breaks. Overall, he a nice guy and cares about his work.

As long as you come to class and do the warmup/dance you should be able to get a high grade. I took Intro to dance, and he understands many of us do not have dancing experience. Professor Murphy is a very goofy man. He is very knowledgeable in dance, and I learned a lot from his class. He cracks lots of jokes. It was very easy overall, just try your best and you will earn an A!
Very sweet professor, I enjoyed every class. I definitely would recommend for anyone who needs a fine art credit or just an elective credit. Very easy, just participate.
Professor Murphy is fun, but you better hope you don't get sick or have someone in your family pass away because he will not excuse your absence and attendance is 80% of the grade.

This class was very fun. I was nervous about it at first, but Professor Murphy made us feel comfortable. You have to participate. This class is not stressful and he will always help you if you don't understand a part of the dance.

Nice guy, bad at responding to emails, takes attendance for a grade, put in effort and get an A, some group dances, must go to dance performances for a grade, very few and easy out of class assignments.

This teacher is my favorite teacher I've had and I am not a school person. He makes every class fun and is the sweetest. The assignments are easy and the class is fun but you also learn a lot in the process. Not overcomplicated!
Professor Murphy is a great professor as long as you put in the effort. If he does not like you or your class you may have a hard time, but overall is a fun class!
he is fun at first gets worse as semester goes on but if you try in his class he will give you a good grade but be ready to dance and sweat

Fun class, really need to practice your dancing if you want a good grade. Doesn't care if you're bad as long as you try. Always cracking  corny jokes ;)

I recommend this class if it's for your major.

Professor He is very knowledgeable in the content she teaches, and is very energetic and passionate with what she does. However be prepared for many assignments, quizzes, homework, and a big group project. If you pay attention to lectures (mostly powerpoint presentations), then you will be golden.
taking an online class, it's hard to rate the professor herself, but her class has a lot of work and she never, ever, responds to emails

Online quizzes with 10 questions but only gives you 10 minutes to do them, half the time I could never finish. She refuses to give you more time. Do not take!!

She's so nice and helpful when you make it clear you need it, but it's hard to understand her sometimes. Quizzes are all online, midterm and final are hardcopy. The group project sucks and is a lot of pressure. She works with you and tries to be helpful. Don't underestimate the class's difficulty.

She is very highly energetic. English isn't her first language so it can be difficult to understand her. Dr. He is adorable, and spunky but do not take get for granted, although her class seems like cake at first, it is pretty complex stuff and it will creep up on you. Lerong is seriously one of the nicest, most genuine professors at Brockport. She truly cares about her students and is energetic and enthusiastic about teaching. If you read the text it helps significantly, but she does give you all the information that you need for the test in  the lecture. Ends with a group presentation and paper but she does an excellent job working with you and grading is fair.

Simply put, Dr. He is Brockport's finest business professor.  She's super smart (Wharton School, just like Donald Trump), and she's also an excellent teacher.  Unlike some, she actually puts something into her lectures, and she's always well-prepared and willing to help.  I hope she stays around for a long time!
Super nice professor with an Ivy League education.  Clear here?

Still taking the class, but so far, so good.  She seems very enthusiastic and helpful.

Professor Eloi's class was complicated and confusing at times. She asked many questions to make sure students understood, however, she is very bad at answering problems outside of class. This is my second time having her, she's so funny and her assignments are really easy but sometimes they're confusing and you need to ask for clarification because sometimes she forgets what she says and you have to remind her. The quizzes were so easy, as long as you read the material before class. She really engages her students with everything.
She is very caring, a fair grader, and gives helpful feedback
Dr Panning cares about her students and gets excited for their writing skills. She is inspirational, motivational and I respect her feedback very much

I have had Panning for ENG210 and now ENG304. I love her classes. She gives such valuable feedback and wants everyone to be a better writer. I have improved as a writer because of her criticisms. She has never once answered an email though, so there's that. But she is an amazing teacher.
She is the reason, or a pretty good part of the reason, why I switched my major to English. She is quirky but very engaging. Try your best and you will do well!

She demands equal participation between all students, even those reluctant to even speak. You are only allowed to ask one question a day and she will only answer it if she feels like it. comment: Very enthusiastic but sometimes disorienting, and you work in groups for almost every major project.

She can be a bit all over the place sometimes but it is clear she loves what she is doing and is passionate for the course material. It is a writing class so be prepared to write almost every class session.

Professor Panning is a fun professor. She's very caring and flexible, so just communicate with her if you have an issue. It's very easy to get a good grade in creative writing as long as you show up prepared and have a good attitude.

She knows what she is talking about, and I did learn some useful information to become a better writer. However, she can have a condescending attitude and I dont appreciate the way she talks to students when she is annoyed. Not a bad person, but she should learn to be more understanding.

Panning is a very kind and understanding professor. There is 4 main papers throughout the semester and we do class activities to help us prepare for them. Homework load is not bad at all. Can sometimes be confusing when giving assignment directions. Does not allow phones out in class & is very strict about enforcing it. Overall good professor.
She is very caring and an easy grader.

Dr. Panning isn't my cup of tea, but I know lots of people that enjoy her classes. She is a pretty fair grader, if you try, and make sure to read the books if she is giving a quiz on them or you won't pass. But, she also comes off very pretentious at times and loves to her herself talk. Sometimes her classes feel more like "The Anne Panning Show."

Dr. Panning is a genuinely kind, caring and gifted professor. I decided to take her class on a whim Fall '15 and it was the best decision I've made in years. She cares about participation and requires that everyone contribute. As a result technology is banned, but this helps to foster more engaging classroom discussion. Highly recommended prof.

I found it hypocritical that Anne gives students the freedom to write what they wish until critique time. Many students felt I was misogynistic or hate-filled because I created villainous narrators & characters. When I talked to Anne, she pushed the feminist narrative on me, seeing all women as victims.  After this I wrote pieces to avoid problems.

Anne is a great professor that any and every English student should learn from at some point during their time at this school. She loves engaging in classroom discussions and is never unclear about what she expects from her students. She makes the classroom fun and is always looking for feedback from her students. She is a great professor!

She is a great teacher! Fantastic woman, and pretty easy grader. She is very very down to Earth, and if you don't like what you got on your essay, she let's you re-write it and hand it in a again. If you go to her office hours, she will go through your essay with you and tell you exactly what you need to do to get a better great. TAKE HER!
She is very open and loves the class to interact and discuss. She may seem a tad weird, but she is a brilliant writing teacher.

Anne is one of the best professors at Brockport.  If you get a chance, TAKE A CLASS WITH HER.  She expects a lot, but you will learn so much from her that it's definitely worth it.  She definitely pushes you to be a better writer.
One of my favorite professors -- great class.  She expects a lot, but is not unreasonable.

I thought Panning was funny and kind throughout the semester.  She isn't afraid to tell you what she thinks about your writing, but all in all, I had a lot of fun in the class.  She's a good teacher, as long as you are never late and you remember to turn your cell phone OFF before class begins...

I do not care for her. She is an extremely tough grader and she rips apart peoples writing. We are there to learn, not to be expert writers, and besides is only a level 200 class. I would not take another class with her. She is a nice lady, but way too critical when it comes to her class.
Anne's great!!! Her class is so comfortable and fun. Workshop classes are great with Anne. Shes very intelligent and I learned a lot.

Hate to rain on parade. Panning is all about Panning. Oh, and Liberalism, of course. Look at me, I write books. Whee golly. Prevalent attitude in Bkpt Eng Dept. They only teach to afford to be writers, which indicates the quality and sales potential of their books. Blah.

Great professor.  Makes challenging subjects interesting, and is always happy to help her students.  Good sense of humor, and very laid back.

Dr. Panning was very invested in her students, and took the time and care to evaluate and give constructive criticism on our work. I learned a great deal from her. She was challenging, yet knew how to make a 3 hour workshop fun and interesting.
Excellent writing prof. Grad workshops were super high quality--makes you work, but in a good way. Very approachable prof.
Great classes.
I had her her first year and she was great. Definitely made a lasting impression. I am now teaching english and still love writing and teaching creative nonfiction!
Makes sure the night class doesn't get boring. She's fun & interesting.  Very fair grader & with the amount of assignments.

comment: This man is a saint. I've taken 3 classes with him, and my only regret is that I should have taken more with him. Dr. Reff is super helpful in lectures, office hours, and by email. I walk away from his classes happy and full of knowledge, a rare combination in math. I'm convinced this man has been sent from the math gods.

This is the first math class I've taken where I didn't have to retreat to youtube math tutorials between every lecture. Reff could teach an old dog new tricks. Reff could teach an old dog calculus. Between excellent lectures and an abundance of online resources including past exams, you're going to leave this class knowing your stuff.

Professor Reff was by far the best Professor I have ever had! I was in the Winter Session College Algebra class online and I did very well. Professor Reff was always very helpful and I would definitely take as many courses as I can with him.

comment: Professor Singh is one of the nicest professors I've ever had. His class involves a lot of work and tough tests but I have learned so much about Investing and Finance in general from him. He gives quizzes on every chapter and every outside reading assignment which are difficult to pass if you don't read.

Quizzes on chapters are given BEFORE he lectures the chapter, you essentially need to learn the chapter before he teaches it.  Very hard test grader. If you're not 100% on the dot he takes away major points. He is a nice guy and pretty funny but be prepared for hard tests and getting quizzed on chapters you havnt gone over yet.

He is a great guy and I loved having a class with him, but the class was tough, no mandatory homework, but reading is a must there is a quiz on every chapter you read. The tests are pretty tough. That being said I would not take this class once a week, have it at least twice a week.

Most knowledgeable Professor at Brockport ! If YOU READ, STUDY, & Attend CLASS YOU wIll Succeed ! You will feel as if you can accomplish any area of Finance with this Dr. Singh's teachings !

comment: His lectures are long and hard to understand. He just talks and talks, he is really smart in economics and expects you to be at his level. The midterm and final were really hard. comment: The class can get boring at times and is pretty lecture heavy, however he tries his best to make macro as exciting as it can get. He knows a lot and is willing to help if needed, he also curves the grades too. If you're required to take macro, I defininetly recommend taking it with him.

He is a very good professor he understands that economics is not for everyone. He also curves to the class average which helps a lot. I would recommend him for someone who really needs a caring professor because he works with his students if had any problems. Also, he is a very funny guy with side jokes.

Wish I chose someone else/ had more words. 1. Gives little to no time to take in-class notes 2. Lots of boring droning, class is a snoozefest 3. comment: Great lecturer, makes it interesting by applying economic concepts to current events. He covers a lot of material, but homework and tests mostly focus on concepts, not memorizing every detail. He is very responsive to email questions and wants students to understand. Go to class and take notes. Highly recommend.

Classes and tests had a strong focus on lecture content, and discussion. Tests/homework were written short answer, extra credit was provided. prof Harwick really does care more about the fact you LEARN the material and provide practical application to the real world, then being able to fill out a bubble sheet. Highly recommended.

Hes a funny teacher and very helpful. Although if you take advanced weight training with him you better not be over weight because the amount you have to lift/squat all depends on how much you weigh. If you are in shape though hes a fun, great teacher.
good. looking.

Honestly, as far as economics go i thought he was a great professor. Kept class as interesting as possible and was pretty funny. Curves tests slightly, know the concepts and you'll make good grades. One easy paper and project as well. Would recommend him as far as macro goes for sure

Tough course, good professor. You need to take the time out of your day to get a good grade and pay attention during lectures and such. Lecture exams will be on the harder side but you need to review the material and make sure you understand the concept over just the idea.

Dr. Rich is awesome, especially if you have him for lab too
BIO 322 is difficult regardless but Dr. Rich tried his best to make it as smooth as the course could be. He is a great professor!

he's pretty chill and not overly serious. exams are hard if you don't study, but if you put some effort into studying then you'll get pretty good grades. he records lectures so if you don't want to attend in person you don't really have to.

He is an amazing professor who knows his stuff and cares about his students. The way he explains things in lectures and the way he just runs his class overall made so much sense to me and helped make a difficult subject easier. He's always willing to help you and answer your questions.

Loved this class. He's reasonable too, and works hard.  Talks about research a lot.

I loved it so much better than A+P 1. The content can seem like a lot and be tough but Dr. Rich tries to make it as reasonable as possible without making it just an "easy A" class. He is such a dad figure and cares about his students. I read the textbook, but you can 100% get away without reading it. Make sure you study the physical models in lab.
Absolutely loves physiology. Has empathy for students.  Sort of funny.  Tells you that he wants you to learn like 1000 times.  And you are going to learn Concentration = amount/ volume!

Best professor I have had at Brockport. Dr. Rich genuinely cares about his students and their education. He will go the extra mile to make sure students understand the material. As much as I enjoy anatomy, this was a very painful class. I stopped watching his lectures half way through the semester because they confused me. Reading the book seems to be the only choice with A&P 2.
One Course. Answers email. Creates videos and lots of helpful stuff. Has bonuses that help you learn.
Good Stories. Favors understanding not memorizing. Fair. Challenging. Enthusiastic about physiology and learning.

One of the best professors I've had at Brockport. He cares about his students so reach out to him, he will help you. I've learned the most in this class than any other class I've taken, and it was also the hardest class I've ever taken at Brockport. It's not impossible if you put in the time and effort. Best advice to follow is to READ THE TEXTBOOK

Dr. Rich was one of the best professors I'v had so far at Brockport but his class was also one of the hardest. Read and go to class. All you can do. Class will give you the ultimate smack down if you dont put in effort.
Everyone says A&P is hard. True. Some say it's unfair. False. You have to do the work. It's extra hard if you have not had chem and bio courses even though they aren't required.

The key to success for this class is reading the book! I never read a book for a class before and but staying ahead of Dr. R in the book made lecture a great experience!
